You know what's funny though, is politics was the last thing I ever wanted to be involved in. After being a cop for so many years and seeing the worst in people, all I wanted to do was be a father to my son.

Then one day, Gavin Newsom and his gang of corrupt politicians decided the Government should in charge of my child, that violent criminals shouldn't be arrested, and that cops were the bad guys in society. So that's when I had to take a stand, because how could I look at my son and tell him things were okay, if I wasn't doing everything in my power to make sure that was true.

We can hope for the best, but if we don’t stand up for ourselves and make sure it goes that way, then there’s no chance we can guarantee a brighter future for us or our children.

[**So do me this favor, take a leap of faith, join forces with a former cop, and let’s finally change things for the better.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=d77edf0c75044f4bb592cbca52809245&_e=kQOhVDPMLlvCzggdqh2_VM5C5QXfNRD2oV4-K-41o0CuzIZzVvMv2-roJCoCX6D-JuQzP8lKtRlXIRdkbgu9j5y5QtKdckyeemeutou3ZRC-tiNcjmNyDlkNN0scWCYls-lu71kHWtJn7Jbaso4HcFKTlqi7mKrLn-jQaBreQiaX0FxKleZeUKVedFQrmhM1bbJIK1kBrHRgrk71EwKXdl69p0wzAvCSvoj9qpkId2x3mfsGdJHTOZBu80vLz2Uh566h9M9C-xvCkJN4veiO1HVef9oUk0ZFC_emP5Aik5wtH7kvuWPvJJyI-AdaTLuk_4TkDHkdcO71b10-QJVowQ%3D%3D)

Let’s make it happen.

**Nick Wilson**

I am a husband to a supportive wife, and the proud father of an amazing 8-year-old son. I have dedicated my life to public service, first as a cop and now as a mental health advocate for first responders.

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.** ➡️

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.
---
| | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=a7f81bfcf2004110b9bb807082c0acbf&_e=eUjiafBP2FMtvdJn7sZ8qKRlQkSanM6jnhSRReRla8oVCvsytEhg-T44EH7lDHI-S6gOIUbWH4JiqYBjekaBjQ6mpC0jiCWOGx6JJy1GA6rn2gqSinrCFLadikN-MVlk353WM02WHjH1YHtx8dXOmJ8UZV7fDwRbwyokzJbrNP2XZLQeAO9feL61g7Gx9fG6Cfl0tKbtOXjIdl0qXf9iCAaU6fGjaq5VDOBMz9eEyd9PzggilhE8Vecwj0caBvJppoCDneYLTTHkuN8vEBEY5hdWXN7ts4wlI5MU5mIkVD7RqcvkN66wDiiqF5qKsvab4QTO0jVpA95EgaG8c45MDBiPdEORShusxquC1U7gNh5CiJPt_GWnU-BfG_JpHd30)
---
When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=a7f81bfcf2004110b9bb807082c0acbf&_e=eUjiafBP2FMtvdJn7sZ8qKRlQkSanM6jnhSRReRla8oVCvsytEhg-T44EH7lDHI-S6gOIUbWH4JiqYBjekaBjQ6mpC0jiCWOGx6JJy1GA6rn2gqSinrCFLadikN-MVlk353WM02WHjH1YHtx8dXOmJ8UZV7fDwRbwyokzJbrNP2XZLQeAO9feL61g7Gx9fG6Cfl0tKbtOXjIdl0qXf9iCAaU6fGjaq5VDOBMz9eEyd97RCRU4PCWyBtbyb7o6kvBxkF3LDhSl_zloqPQogoJAX6sYeblVCq7lNVOqkrOuo6aefEBDdFjQ4DwrThwN75zGiHrA5sn58rtzLvRW1My7croOWrT3y-TyoCShBrr1NgvBNWslE3Mi_jVRtLjsA5i)

Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. **To my core, I believe the most important things are God, family, and country.**

**_I believe that God is not done with America yet._**

**I believe we need to unite as a party and unite as a nation. The hour is late, and the crisis is great – but I am bullish about the future of America.**

I believe in the law – I’m a constitutional law attorney and I respect the law.

I believe in the law – I’m a constitutional law attorney and I respect the law. I believe America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of the world – but our days as the beacon of freedom for the world are numbered if we let the far-left force their anti-American agenda on the rest of us. Fellow American, I know it takes time to build trust; you’re getting to know me and I’m navigating this new role – but we must act – and quickly. Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

Friends.

I hope this message finds you well. As we kick off the Festival of Lights, **I want to wish you a happy first night of Hanukkah!**

May this season bring you warmth, joy, and memorable moments with your loved ones. Hanukkah, the Festival of Lights, holds a special place in our hearts as it symbolizes hope, resilience, and the triumph of light over darkness.

**Those truths are especially meaningful this year.**

I encourage you to take this time to cherish family and friends, appreciate the blessings that surround us, and be a light in the world for our collective humanity.

Best wishes,

subject: The Senate Democrats introduced an assault weapons ban
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Brian Williams for Congress
body:
| | Peter,

On Tuesday, Senate Democrats introduced legislation to reinstate the assault weapons ban. The very next day, Republicans blocked this life-saving legislation. I'm ready to go to Washington and work to pass an assault weapons ban, but I need your support. **[Will you make a donation to my campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74773116/442607963/1416552317?refcode=em23_231205_AWBRR_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_231205_AWBRR_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=5b1b9c91-5f95-ee11-8925-002248223f36&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWIxYjljOTEtNWY5NS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=tu4VvQVdPr-M2WCQrcPjtSxi8aJfeKS73TkB6BbDwpk=)**

As an eighteen-year-old cadet at the US Air Force Academy, I underwent weapons training on the M-16, the military version of the AR-15. At the end of a day, our weapons went into secure storage. We understood the dangers of this weapon and knew it had no business threatening our communities of untrained civilians.

As a trauma surgeon, I’ve seen firsthand the devastating toll gun violence has on patients, communities, and our country. As of this month, 2023 is officially the deadliest year on record for mass shootings – with more than 40,000 lives lost.

The headlines are a constant reminder of just how deadly life has become. Just yesterday, six people lost their lives at the hands of a gunman in Austin and San Antonio. In the same night, three people were gunned down at the University of Nevada Las Vegas. **Assault weapons are weapons of war and have no place on our streets.**

We can end this never-ending cycle of gun violence and carnage. We've taken action in the past, and it’s time for our government to do it again.

**Mass shootings decreased during the decade of the assault weapons ban from '94-'04, and had an immediate and steep increase after it expired.** We can promote healing in our communities with legislation that centers on saving Americans.

**[It’s long past time to reinstate the assault weapons ban in America. Senate Democrats are taking bold steps toward reform, but we need to ensure this legislation has the support of a Democratic-led House if we want any chance of seeing it signed into law. Chip in $5, or whatever you can to this campaign to help Democrats reclaim the House in 2024>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74773117/442607964/1416552317?refcode=em23_231205_AWBRR_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_231205_AWBRR_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=5b1b9c91-5f95-ee11-8925-002248223f36&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWIxYjljOTEtNWY5NS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=tu4VvQVdPr-M2WCQrcPjtSxi8aJfeKS73TkB6BbDwpk=)**

clean_body: | | Peter, On Tuesday, Senate Democrats introduced legislation to reinstate the assault weapons ban. The very next day, Republicans blocked this life-saving legislation. I'm ready to go to Washington and work to pass an assault weapons ban, but I need your support. = As an eighteen-year-old cadet at the US Air Force Academy, I underwent weapons training on the M-16, the military version of the AR-15. At the end of a day, our weapons went into secure storage. We understood the dangers of this weapon and knew it had no business threatening our communities of untrained civilians. As a trauma surgeon, I’ve seen firsthand the devastating toll gun violence has on patients, communities, and our country. As of this month, 2023 is officially the deadliest year on record for mass shootings – with more than 40,000 lives lost. The headlines are a constant reminder of just how deadly life has become. Just yesterday, six people lost their lives at the hands of a gunman in Austin and San Antonio. In the same night, three people were gunned down at the University of Nevada Las Vegas. Assault weapons are weapons of war and have no place on our streets. We can end this never-ending cycle of gun violence and carnage. We've taken action in the past, and it’s time for our government to do it again. Mass shootings decreased during the decade of the assault weapons ban from '94-'04, and had an immediate and steep increase after it expired. body:
I am from the same cloth as everybody; I am a working West Virginian.

| | | [ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQfxYEUJ-nO76EnecZp2cVBgIDwk_0hNpPXtCvk7UZaSh&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=120723_we_are_surging&n=1)
---
Dear Friend, While the news stories about the campus shooting on the University of Nevada, Las Vegas campus and the ongoing retaliation of the Israeli government against Palestinian civilians can make it difficult to trust that the political process we as a campaign are engaging in can be impactful, the many conversations I have around the state reassure me about our mission. Nearly every interaction ends with voters appreciating my directness, clarity, commitment to working-class issues, and uncompromising support of human rights everywhere and for everyone. The campaign is surging, and the media, like [this Business Insider article](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=GUadKUZbNtXpoQtrN7XiLlDAp0T1nvsEvUIUmB084zGfnK7UUBg_CUhJKBGbLNDAsDqUokMH2UHD0joBrveGngDibmmp8sUkBVYgGzGqCgzVz5JOXFKJWWBT4z4YdBDkK0JFXyBGPR4kiOsyUltX1g&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=120723_we_are_surging&n=2), provides voters and supporters glimpses of the kind of policies I will champion domestically and what sort of world I want to see my son be part of. **[Help us deliver for West Virginians and all Americans by joining our campaign today as a donor. Every dollar helps, and your monthly contribution would help us better staff the robust on-the-ground operation we are building.](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQfxYEUJ-nO76EnecZp2cVBgIDwk_0hNpPXtCvk7UZaSh&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=120723_we_are_surging&n=3)**
---

My political opinions started to form when I joined the Marine Corps and were influenced by the Occupy Wall Street movement. Seeing people around me working hard yet unable to make ends meet made me realize how it is not the merit that matters in our country but whether you have a wealthy family, what network you can lean on, and what advantages your upbringing provides. The United States is no longer a land of opportunity for my generation, but this is precisely why we are running this campaign.**** **I am from the same cloth as everybody; I am a working West Virginian.** [With your help, I will be the Senator you can count on and trust. Can I count on you pitching in $10 towards our historic campaign?](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQfxYEUJ-nO76EnecZp2cVBgIDwk_0hNpPXtCvk7UZaSh&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=120723_we_are_surging&n=5) With gratitude, Zach

| We have a saying that is part of a Jewish principle — “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. I carry that with me each day in my work.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4691%2E5257348%2EZXgbW9)
Hi Derek, as we begin the Hanukkah celebration, I wanted to share this photo of Eve’s and my first Hanukkah as a family with Lexi.
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=dec2023_abs_em.181qVM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC30_20231207_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=4691%2E5257348%2EZXgbW9)
My faith was a big part of my upbringing — it’s where my parents, my brother, and I found a community when we moved to the Bay Area when I was a kid at Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California. Eve and I have passed that tradition down to our own kids.
And like my parents before me, I’ve tried to cultivate a love and respect for public service in our family — and the values that command us to do what’s right for the next generation.
As families around the country celebrate the first night of Hanukkah this evening, I’m reminded of the lessons I learned about this holiday growing up. Lessons about the significance of the eight lights as a symbol of unity, strength, perseverance, and freedom.
**We have a saying that is part of a Jewish principle — “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. I carry that with me each day in my work.**
In recent years, there’s a lot that’s been broken, and a lot to fix. I’m ready to do my part to leave our state and country in a better place for our children and our grandchildren. I’m committed to repairing our broken democracy.
I’m doing my part to live the principle of “Tikkun Olam,” and I know you are too.
**[As we approach the end of the year and our final FEC fundraising deadline before my primary election, your support is crucial to my continuing work. Together, we can continue the tradition of repairing the world. With that in mind, will you pitch in $5 to help?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1230?c0=dec2023_abs_em._zEiYK&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC30_20231207_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=4691%2E5257348%2EZXgbW9)**

name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: Thanks to your support, this state is the latest to commit to 100% clean energy.
body:
Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA:
PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS
The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur.

Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again.

GOAL: 5,000 actions
TAKE ACTION https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/rNykfkKb_ ? ?
? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents.

This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health.

Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces.

Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ambdFry-

We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks.

But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers.

Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters.

Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters.

Sincerely,

Madeleine Foote
Deputy Legislative Director
League of Conservation Voters ? ? ? ? ? This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. **But even if we don’t talk about them much, the reality is we have to take our Republican challengers seriously.** In 2020, Alexandria was in the second most expensive House race in the country. Her challenger raised and spent more than $10 million against her.
Alexandria already has two Republican opponents — and this morning, one of them posted a video claiming that Alexandria is “destroying New York and America.” **Outside groups have committed to spending big money to defeat Alexandria next year.**

Fellow American, The fourth Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you 're just tuning into the race after this pivotal debate, I'd like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I'm running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I'm asking for your support.** _**Here 's my story**_: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation's freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.

---
| [](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=30be9634d72c44bcac2707196b77fa0f&_e=ih1YdoEqE7eXnmPcRQGAKRmZ-38f-i7QH0i87kmuD1ly588vx-sqHceniHfbcuOrf5dTI_GTs9IM6ql2LPhA4pn5HYL_myj0inayZ7Cz_05Bel8xTuQYDhrT7f3VYyQ3HExEKCoBdflSnZeOgKn9dcY5DpaQA9deLIhoO1ye9mGv26nuXgYhDYvP8URbYJqRq1KVrI8PK6LGsJPR9WeKOe46oMF_ZTBSZL1dsV1G5EMoE_fNfJ8Q3-4QdJp8BuPx7uX-9fYAX6ns5ikBQxDQ8sQvGwWmQQAez4wDekhVfZ8ysHo2L81kMH0R2qJyI7kcTcRhmK97kw-jFBmVK63We8gE3_p0ljSwBnXRAZB5TSPiWKtEp6ZcakSlYzGy_KxdpC6SrNzaKDEfkxfk2H4UVw%3D%3D)

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That's why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:
* Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;
* Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;
* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom.

#
Peter,
Before we ask you to chip in $3 or more to our campaign to elect Lucas Kunce to Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, **here are three reasons why national Republicans have made Josh Hawley and our race their top defensive target in 2024:**

1. **Polling shows Josh Hawley is the most unpopular incumbent GOP U.S. Senator running in this election cycle.** Surveys from _Morning Consult_ continue to find Hawley’s approval sinking among Missouri voters, with numbers even worse than Ted Cruz in Texas and Rick Scott in Florida.

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=34392%2E3422442%2EhGIrd6)
Derek,
Here’s a naked and sometimes uncomfortable truth about every single candidate emailing you for $5 to help them get elected: they want power.
**I’m not excluded from that statement. But what we should ask every single candidate, every day, is what they will _do_ with that power.**
Prior to Trump being elected, I never considered running for office. I didn’t work my way up to Congress or serve in student government. I was a law professor and consumer protection advocate who studied and saw how big corporations were cheating the rest of us. When I first ran for office in 2018, I was (and still am!) a single mom of three school age kids who drives a minivan.
**Now, I’m running for the U.S. Senate because I want the power to go after the corrupt special interests that are making it difficult for families to get ahead.** Oil companies need to be held accountable for their messes. Health insurance and pharmaceutical companies need to be held accountable for breaking laws, and for lobbying for a healthcare system that exists to serve their bottom lines. And corporations and the ultra-wealthy need to be held accountable when they cheat on their taxes.
**Our current system is not good enough, and it’s not going to be “good enough” to just go back to the way things were before Donald Trump.** I’ve never taken a dime from corporate PACs and I don’t take money from federal lobbyists—you can always count on me to fight for working people and shake up the status quo.
My mentor and former law professor Elizabeth Warren taught me that nobody gets elected alone. It’s true! I can’t do this without you. [**If you’re able, please consider making a contribution to our campaign today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231207-2?refcode=EMAO23_2_POW_20231207_V1_F&refcode2=34392_3422442_hGIrd6&akid=34392%2E3422442%2EhGIrd6)

Thanks so much for being a part of our campaign.
Katie

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=EMAO23_2_POW_20231207_V1_F&t=2&refcode2=34392_3422442_hGIrd6&akid=34392%2E3422442%2EhGIrd6)**

Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=b0ebe1d0d83b402a8476e4d4a316b920&_e=FS3VqG4Ps0-T5AEuyAXClJ-HS2lLWFpynL-FIZVHgz-lz1ZOy8am0P7c5iYdC0f9V9Uj3Q9tA91OwItFJEprwWDfIWMMBT7BuSsbE8seY1MeRoj6tPLQHpLPoYOu2ETfNvVca5qe1hfXmkjbv9LFBjioDvkE4rMzusAVM140XOtlSzwrJQ5bwPn4bhyY-2P3VlxlyD2b8dYWWkdFd1bOd3zFNtm4iWEEHgIqnc8MyB1COxQGxVXRZgPaKO5Tz_UubIm7utMfmfnWDhnSK2p6EHRjw9rt5xYDTCXqqLLp9wiBQS49jwtw2jq9yaqJy4VSit83KDktt3vXVvrqP4hB06rBu28-4iCTzzzi2cF_UuhndxJggqNeUkKZInBkO_QX)**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable._**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=b0ebe1d0d83b402a8476e4d4a316b920&_e=FS3VqG4Ps0-T5AEuyAXClJ-HS2lLWFpynL-FIZVHgz-lz1ZOy8am0P7c5iYdC0f9V9Uj3Q9tA91OwItFJEprwWDfIWMMBT7BuSsbE8seY1MeRoj6tPLQHpLPoYOu2ETfNvVca5qe1hfXmkjbv9LFBjioDvkE4rMzusAVM140XOtlSzwrJQ5bwPn4bhyY-2P3VlxlyD2b8dYWWkdFd1bOd3zFNtm4iWEEHgIqnc8MyB2Cu7aau_DxZRKOS6QzQ2t3r84iJY0wuneBCnip6jnONMCZADbMNJ5r96o7llyEs_qdpv_VnntOPT6jKg1aTzFFtUPDMVE0LXTPXn1wymvrw0FKSRTm16benKKNGGXZxPQvwq5JtuEAoU2aSjXbyqE0)

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.** ➡️

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.
---
| | [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=b0ebe1d0d83b402a8476e4d4a316b920&_e=FS3VqG4Ps0-T5AEuyAXClJ-HS2lLWFpynL-FIZVHgz-lz1ZOy8am0P7c5iYdC0f9V9Uj3Q9tA91OwItFJEprwWDfIWMMBT7BuSsbE8seY1MeRoj6tPLQHpLPoYOu2ETfNvVca5qe1hfXmkjbv9LFBjioDvkE4rMzusAVM140XOtlSzwrJQ5bwPn4bhyY-2P3VlxlyD2b8dYWWkdFd1bOd3zFNtm4iWEEHgIqnc8MyB35MxI61qsS6t77c_nJ_XnVC0-C5QBooQ5v7n6jLpKtnHtFR2pMoCaiCUZLaLAweVyaRdSzDiVWC6aBTfh0POkLzVnEhYBvH2Dhqv_KeJBvNFZ3jtR2V5LPOgcUY3mRyWyRP_2cGO8EifjWxxdJ-VUc)
---
When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

Let's be honest, very few people want to wear hearing aids. Although there have been huge breakthroughs in technology, most people don't use them simply because they think they are still big and ugly. However, Marco and Paul wanted to change this perception with a **revolutionary device developed with top German hearing aid engineers formerly from Siemens.**

But now, a **game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry** , and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they’ve seen in over a decade.

It’s called **Horizon by hear.com.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time--when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **Horizon has taken the U.S. by storm since its release in early 2023** , offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[ Check if you qualify ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686072%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=OFsR2BRJMICPfXwmfhyg7g&sysid=1)

Although there have been huge breakthroughs in technology, most people don't use them simply because they think they are still big and ugly. However, Marco and Paul wanted to change this perception with a **revolutionary device developed with top German hearing aid engineers formerly from Siemens.**

But now, a **game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry** , and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's called **Horizon by hear.com.**

And it's the perfect solution at the perfect time--when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It's no wonder **Horizon has taken the U.S. by storm since its release in early 2023** , offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.

It's one of **the world 's first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This means that Horizon offers all of the usual benefits of a modern hearing aid--from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming--with the added bonus of something completely new: it can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

"It's not just about volume," explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. "It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what Horizon is designed to optimize."

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity --and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

subject: Get your copy of the 2024 Pathway to Victory Devotional today
body:
With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zd4la0h1d6lk5ldugap4r34ttfc5u24haktt5esg_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c1j6ao34cth2bs)
---
____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zljmqs8f0d2dhs931n1ollg0m9mqdj9qsvba1b0o_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c1j6ao34cth2bs)
---
| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpdsco4j39qeqj4t4t3so4jbsa7s6nrgn2b7mgj8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c1j6ao34cth2bs).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I'm very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress

I can charge my cell phone and iPad at the same time, run an electric razor, my radio, an electric blanket and so much more. It's so easy to take with you anywhere - very light!"_ _Craig W.
Police Officer
_ [**➡ YES! I Want to Protect My Family Today With Life-Saving Solar Power!**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686082%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5TbOIUQjjFAnkL2Q0dab2w&sysid=1) **More Raving Reviews From Customers** | | **Rita L.** This product is so versatile, and at only 8 lbs, my grandchildren can get it. We had many trees down from a storm. The guys kept having to refill their gas powered chainsaws. My husband came out with this "little" box and his electric chainsaw. They laughed and said a long electric cord would be too dangerous. My husband calmly hooked up his Sidekick and made short work at lopping off the branches and then walked through the path he made. It lasted longer than the gas 'polluting' machines. Very grateful you have made this available to buy at an affordable price.
---|---
| **Steve G.** Peace of mind for years. I purchased this product to provide power to run a box fan in the summer and lights in the winter. I can use this product every day for over four years as it can be recharged up to 2,000 times. It won't make noise that draws attention and can create comfort in a difficult situation. Best of all, it's portable.
---|---
| **Thomas B.** Saved my CPAP machine during the winter storms. I just survived the ice storm, the freeze and the power outage in Texas using my 4Patriots products. I was most happy about my Patriot Power Sidekick. It's quiet. It's clean. I was able to deploy the solar panels on the dashboard of my van, it charged up. And then that night I plugged in my CPAP machine and it ran it all night long. With enough to charge my phone in the morning.
---|---
| **Jana H.** Portable power was a blessing when the grid failed us. I didn't think I'd need this but I needed it shortly after receiving it. This past February was the worst freeze that we, in Texas, have seen in a long time. Our power grid failed big time. We were without power for a couple of days. This product was a blessing. We were able to have a light and a small portable TV. I highly recommend this product and the company that sells it.
---|---
| **Allan D.** Patriot Power Sidekick to the rescue. We brought our new Patriot Power Sidekick with us on our last camping trip and it was a blessing. Our primary use was to power an air pump to easily fill up our air mattress for a comfortable night's sleep. One night we had a pinhole leak in the air mattress, so we just kept the Sidekick inside the tent hooked up to the air pump and ran it for a few minutes about every 3 hours to keep it fully inflated. It's quiet and powerful, and we will have it with us on every camping trip!
---|---
| **Chris S.** Power out, no problem. Recently had a power outage due to some crazy storms. I use my phone for everything. Having the sidekick charged up and charging my nearly dead phone meant I was able to have my alarm and get to work on time. Thank you for this compact, lightweight and fume free portable charging/light station available for when I needed it the most!
---|---
| **Richard B.** Well worth it! This is one of the items that made me a loyal customer. I never was a big fan on solar-powered anything. At the same time I've been in enough situations to know any type of a generator is necessary when you live in a more rural setting. Especially when gas prices go through the roof. I purchased the Sidekick and as soon as it arrived I unpacked it and plugged it into a lamp and left it plugged in all evening. I was impressed how little it took from the battery! After 3 hours the Sidekick was still at 98% fully charged. I'm looking forward to having two Sidekicks!
---|---
| **Frank S.** We have been looking for quite a while for something like this. The deal with the solar panels included was something not to pass up! We both have sleep apnea and use c/bipap machines for sleep. The power went out recently and the sidekick worked great. As a test we ran the Sidekick on the humidifier and it ran about 7 hours! It's a small humidifier. That's not bad for that type of application. Cannot wait till camping season comes along! We highly recommend this product.
---|---

name: CaucusRoom
subject: Caucus Room Member Communication
body:
No images? [Click here](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-e-aihjtz-trhiujldw-j/) [](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aihjtz-trhiujldw-r/) **Caucus Room Members**
# **_What 's Wrong with a Free Lunch?_**
## Nothing, except it's not free. Someone pays for lunch.
### The most common question I have been getting as I discuss the "Factory Reset" coming January 1 is "Why won't Groups be free?" Let me address that question directly.
As conservatives, we understand that any product or service costs something to provide. Free markets mean that buyers and sellers are free to decide whether to transact with each other or not. There is no coercion. There is freedom to choose. The products and services are not "free".Creating the Caucus Room platform has taken more than four years and large amounts of funding. Ongoing operations require ongoing expenditures to keep the "lights on", maintain the site and provide improvements and bug fixes. We have decided to take off the training wheels and see whether Caucus Room can take off on its own as it supports conservatives in their change efforts through providing virtual meeting places.With the internet, there are various ways to "monetize" the activity of content users. Buying and selling products is the most straightforward, and easily understood. Sites can also sell advertising based on the user base. Sites can provide access to their users by selling on site promotions to third parties The most misunderstood by users of websites is the sale of their user data to third parties.Caucus Room has decided intentionally that it will no longer sell advertising or access to our Members by third parties beginning January 1. We have never sold our Members' data or information and will not in the future. Those choices are what we believe are in the best interests of our Members and our purpose. That leaves a single avenue to pay for "lunch": Charging a fee for Group usage. Membership in your neighborhood will continue to be provided without cost to the Members.The pricing established for Groups to form on Caucus Room Live of $24 per month for groups up to 50 Members and $50 for groups larger than 50 is intended to be cost competitive, particularly when you consider what you are unknowingly giving away on so-called "free" sites. We look forward to finding out from you over the next few months whether we are providing a platform of value greater to you than the cost. That is what makes for a very good lunch.
### Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
### John Coors
Manager, Caucus Room LLCjohnc@caucusroom.com

[](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aihjtz-trhiujldw-y/) | CaucusRoom, LLCPO Box 745214Arvada, CO 80006 You are receiving this email because you are a valued member of CaucusRoom [Preferences](https://caucusroom.updatemyprofile.com/i-aihjtz-6F882DBF-trhiujldw-t) | [Unsubscribe](https://caucusroom.cmail20.com/t/i-u-aihjtz-trhiujldw-i/)

[**Order Today and Get $243 of FREE Gifts!**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3e9esr95hp7ncqfmlvm736b3u35vtnco1da03r8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c1gm0ob6c9h2bs) Small and mighty, the Patriot Power Sidekick is your personal "portable power plant" that can power your phones, laptops, medical devices, radios and more! * Silent, Fume-FREE & Safe
* Fast Recharge
* Long-Lasting Battery
* Recharge 2,000 Times!

* Powers Your Favorite Devices
* FREE Portable 40-Watt Solar Panel Included
* and more!

That's why it's our privilege to introduce to you: [**The Patriot Power Sidekick
Is An Essential Part of
Your Preparedness Plan!**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zer1oj8ar845lhkma9uv627vr4odmsgbkgck24m8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c1gm0ob6c9h2bs) [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zp688bm7i4225rsgafkcgsvmp4akam17n1csda48_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c1gm0ob6c9h2bs) _"I really like how many things the Sidekick can run. I can charge my cell phone and iPad at the same time, run an electric razor, my radio, an electric blanket and so much more. It's so easy to take with you anywhere - very light!"_ _Craig W.
Police Officer
_ [**➡ YES! I Want to Protect My Family Today With Life-Saving Solar Power!**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zast245a7t6r2p7u2l5hia4o6ih8vg667tgb1u1o_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c1gm0ob6c9h2bs) **More Raving Reviews From Customers** | | **Rita L.** This product is so versatile, and at only 8 lbs, my grandchildren can get it. We had many trees down from a storm. The guys kept having to refill their gas powered chainsaws. My husband came out with this "little" box and his electric chainsaw. They laughed and said a long electric cord would be too dangerous. My husband calmly hooked up his Sidekick and made short work at lopping off the branches and then walked through the path he made. It lasted longer than the gas 'polluting' machines. Very grateful you have made this available to buy at an affordable price.
---|---
| **Steve G.** Peace of mind for years. I purchased this product to provide power to run a box fan in the summer and lights in the winter. I can use this product every day for over four years as it can be recharged up to 2,000 times. It won't make noise that draws attention and can create comfort in a difficult situation. Best of all, it's portable.
---|---
| **Thomas B.** Saved my CPAP machine during the winter storms. I just survived the ice storm, the freeze and the power outage in Texas using my 4Patriots products. I was most happy about my Patriot Power Sidekick. It's quiet. It's clean. I was able to deploy the solar panels on the dashboard of my van, it charged up. And then that night I plugged in my CPAP machine and it ran it all night long. With enough to charge my phone in the morning.
---|---
| **Jana H.** Portable power was a blessing when the grid failed us. I didn't think I'd need this but I needed it shortly after receiving it. This past February was the worst freeze that we, in Texas, have seen in a long time. Our power grid failed big time. We were without power for a couple of days. This product was a blessing. We were able to have a light and a small portable TV. I highly recommend this product and the company that sells it.
---|---
| **Allan D.** Patriot Power Sidekick to the rescue. We brought our new Patriot Power Sidekick with us on our last camping trip and it was a blessing. Our primary use was to power an air pump to easily fill up our air mattress for a comfortable night's sleep. One night we had a pinhole leak in the air mattress, so we just kept the Sidekick inside the tent hooked up to the air pump and ran it for a few minutes about every 3 hours to keep it fully inflated. It's quiet and powerful, and we will have it with us on every camping trip!
---|---
| **Chris S.** Power out, no problem. Recently had a power outage due to some crazy storms. I use my phone for everything. Having the sidekick charged up and charging my nearly dead phone meant I was able to have my alarm and get to work on time. Thank you for this compact, lightweight and fume free portable charging/light station available for when I needed it the most!
---|---
| **Richard B.** Well worth it! This is one of the items that made me a loyal customer. I never was a big fan on solar-powered anything. At the same time I've been in enough situations to know any type of a generator is necessary when you live in a more rural setting. Especially when gas prices go through the roof. I purchased the Sidekick and as soon as it arrived I unpacked it and plugged it into a lamp and left it plugged in all evening. I was impressed how little it took from the battery! After 3 hours the Sidekick was still at 98% fully charged. I'm looking forward to having two Sidekicks!
---|---
| **Frank S.** We have been looking for quite a while for something like this. The deal with the solar panels included was something not to pass up! We both have sleep apnea and use c/bipap machines for sleep. The power went out recently and the sidekick worked great. As a test we ran the Sidekick on the humidifier and it ran about 7 hours! It's a small humidifier. That's not bad for that type of application. Cannot wait till camping season comes along! We highly recommend this product.
---|---

name: Marjorie Dannenfelser
subject: Let our lawmakers know you stand for life!
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsJnWVCiNZ

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osJnWVCiNZ

Pro-Life Advocate,

I'm writing to you today as a
passionate protector of vulnerable women and the unborn. I know
that you share my belief that every human life is precious and
should be protected.

I've been a pro-life activist for
over 20 years, and I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of
abortion on women, children, and families. I've met women who
have had abortions and dealt with the pain and regret as they
navigate a deeply felt loss in their lives. I've met children who
were born after their mothers were denied an abortion and who are
now thriving. And I've met families who have been torn apart by
abortion.

I know that you're also aware of
the recent Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This
is a historic victory for the pro-life movement, but this was
just the beginning of the fight. We still have a long way to go
to ensure that all unborn babies and their mothers are protected
from abortion.

The first step is for pro-life
Americans to come together and state what we believe and what we
will do in order to protect the unborn. Will you join me in
standing up for the rights of unborn children?

When you sign the pledge, you'll
be joining a growing movement of pro-life Americans who are
working to make a difference. You'll also be receiving regular
updates from SBA Pro-Life America about the latest pro-life news
and events.

SIGN THE PLEDGE »

I know that you care
about the unborn, the protections for mothers and their babies
and I know that you want to make a difference. I hope you'll join
me in signing the SBA Pro-Life America Pledge to Stand Up for the
Unborn. Together, we can build a pro-life America where every
child is welcomed and valued.

For LIFE,

Marjorie Dannenfelser

name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Your Signature is Needed: Protect Louisiana wetlands and communities
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2182571?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Tell the Department of Energy to REJECT a catastrophic liquefied natural gas project in Louisiana! >>** **[Sign the petition now!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2182572?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** Picture this: a sea of green weeds reaching out of the water. Cattails and oyster beds. The coastal wetlands of Louisiana sustain local communities and their fishing economies. They also protect the coasts against flooding and storm surges from climate-fueled hurricanes. The Department of Energy is considering a massive export gas facility that would **DESTROY coastal wetlands** and spew **toxic pollution into the environment and communities!** The good news is that this project isn’t approved yet – and **your urgent message to the DOE could help STOP this dangerous gas facility!** **[Please, Friend, protect coastal communities and wetlands and tell the Department of Energy to REJECT the CP2 LNG gas project!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2182573?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2182574?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
The proposed export facility will have consequences for people outside of Louisiana too. The emissions it would create is the equivalent to **51 coal-fired power plants!** To put it another way, that’s **42-million gas powered cars.** This facility is a ticking **CLIMATE-BOMB** if approved.
As storms surge and fires rage with increasing intensity every year, we can’t afford to build more fossil fuel infrastructure that will spiral our planet into further climate catastrophe. Louisiana communities can’t afford more fossil fuel pollution harming their communities and destroying their coasts. **[Tell the Department of Energy to REJECT the CP2 LNG gas export facility! Sign by 11:59pm TONIGHT!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2182575?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2182574?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Standing with you,
Lukas Ross
Senior Program Manager,
Friends of the Earth**

Cattails and oyster beds. The coastal wetlands of Louisiana sustain local communities and their fishing economies. They also protect the coasts against flooding and storm surges from climate-fueled hurricanes. The Department of Energy is considering a massive export gas facility that would DESTROY coastal wetlands and spew toxic pollution into the environment and communities! The good news is that this project isn’t approved yet – and your urgent message to the DOE could help STOP this dangerous gas facility! == | == The proposed export facility will have consequences for people outside of Louisiana too. The emissions it would create is the equivalent to 51 coal-fired power plants! To put it another way, that’s 42-million gas powered cars. This facility is a ticking CLIMATE-BOMB if approved. As storms surge and fires rage with increasing intensity every year, we can’t afford to build more fossil fuel infrastructure that will spiral our planet into further climate catastrophe. Louisiana communities can’t afford more fossil fuel pollution harming their communities and destroying their coasts. == == Standing with you, Lukas Ross Senior Program Manager, Friends of the Earth | Contact Us: Friends of the Earth U.S. Washington, D.C. | Berkeley, CA 1-877-843-8687 foe.org/about-us/contact/

## Hunter Biden Indicted in California
Hunter Biden [has been indicted](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8GNiJ8JhgPDF28pWtHC8PZXEUgIpe0_fuqmTu_Jz3pfVzWS6BC9XgPV_S8tzVEpieuAyinYFyNTH5HBBwl-mHSoI1xxsrskzlPGwAg7mYONsCY0E1Rz5uxSdsoyYOGcQDthkFrfT7hZPa0QbTJzS5ZFEZjIm799Nmocsa9_LQn9lNsV1l8Zr7dxfgmYBGwcMZMpfwxAUvH41ECU6sCltgendUWmAveBSxmNLMenMqPytjVRgmropooMibVquLwrWIO_Xjpsvt0-6JS6G4nYfRxDfTqSP73yG8AAAD__wjuYtk) for tax fraud by a federal grand jury in California. There are nine charges in all, and three are felony charges related to evading taxes and filing false returns. Special counsel David Weiss is [bringing the charges against Biden](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAQQL_GbEbnswNm8NDFW7p2RI59hKsMRuCE5u-rdO7-pPf0vq7jNXDm9f4ZFnJ1KmOIlZ80KpRWoh5Nk9xEhKQbcqoHBGOs6ZrZdWC6OAyopqj0hcBGS6gMDkDDJWlq2CGgVghWKQC4tNSbKd0wdskONnUkDFDiWvb2u_BaZ5ryqzxpb2NZmuzmWrdD6A-BXqA_z7PdSubKsbwBgX6l8xDo3xaBXqFAD71APz_WSru8caJVxjnsd0pyCpwfO8ktvGQNP3RIAKWh76HZXdpOzpmPrhcG7kvg_NdQ_z3yGwAA__9y_1-R); he's the same prosecutor that charged Hunter with illegally possessing a gun in Delaware. Weiss and Biden's legal team had previously agreed to a plea deal that would have limited the charges to misdemeanors and likely kept the president's son out of jail, but the [deal fell apart](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLuSqzAQRL9GZKJGw0sEBDch8003pGQ0wLhkxKLBrP9-C8ebdXC6uut83Yab48Dr_N89qZMpDm4UftFgUFuNxVBmvpuIkIqMOtMAQlnass6WrvJ1Yc0E5G093n07FaapmtaYkdqqNVXGHQIWBsEaAwBVTk05-TuOtbet9TWpEsizxD1_RF5loSm844v2fIzPLHSLyJZU8U9hr7A_zzPfYmDhMV6Awn6lMynsrxWFPTRXrhX2y7EK7frOnla9BXI-6TWKng8O8tYStbgfPS5unylpN13w4_Az6e-DknBc06emPbmgAQzYAky2d347OQROdaNKmJ-Ow-eq_CnuNwAA__8Rc26f) under the questioning of a federal judge in July. After the plea deal failed, Attorney General Merrick Garland made Weiss (then the U.S. Attorney for Delaware) a special counsel, and that new status lifted geographical restrictions on Weiss's authority, allowing him to charge Biden in California without the aid of a local prosecutor. Hunter Biden may now face [two separate criminal trials](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDtu6zAQAE8jdTTI5dcFi9e482tTCityaW1AS4JI28ntA6dOOZhmMB_X6Ypceb39xzvFXrYJU-cnTQpEEKAnM-ZYiID0SFF5CdKYYNy4RIdW2TyXM3lwRabgLZDSGIKWAXUaOYIErUAGpaSU9kTelDxDcjmcQ3Y0GEmZ-3acPjde-0Klfm9POk5pu481Lr3vbdD_BrgMcMF9pVd7qzccnVOlAS7LY-10iJkzraLjl0gLHjdqou2UGKtI22NtVIW3MyBKW8B4q63z3lhTCuSCPnlVxiPm_cW1cnN-MPJ2R66_Jf3PLz8BAAD__9XvYyw) in 2024, and the tax charges in California carry the threat of serious jail time.
## House Sets Formal Probe of Top Colleges
The House Education Committee launched a formal investigation Thursday into antisemitism at three top colleges after their presidents refused to directly condemn calls for Jewish genocide as "hate speech." [Here's video of one exchange.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjz1vgzAUAH-NvQX5i4cZPFSq2NK16oSM_RxcmTiFF1D666t0znonnXSf5_Hsc8nXy4df0FGqow-UdxylOtmT0qPh0SVEhZqjk51QwhhrgM_Oy6nvA4AHLRNASGC6aQLbAqrYQuLZKaG0VMJKKYRoG-xMipMKEG1vIyAzAmOmujbfNV9pxlQedce1CXXhxc1Et43pN6YGpobjOJpHvdN9wqd_Ek9hZnrYmX7_2X_F10pI48ZXF29HLiVv0DEjLovP5T9JLwf_AgAA__-LqlH7) Committee chair Virginia Foxx called the responses "absolutely unacceptable" and threatened to use subpoenas to gather[ the "substantial" number of documents](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uwyAUxfGngY0IX7BNBoYu3tK1o0XhEm7Fh2UTR337Kh06df5J50j_j9t6c5Sp3t9dQdtjW53vdOI6gDAC1Kp5sBERUHG0wyxBam30xJMNHpwyyoyjD_N01aMfI0Tvo4_6OoTAyYIENYA0wyClHC846xg-wU_BXE2YkGmJgXrbL1-Nak8Y83c7cb_4Vni2qfftYOqNwcJg6QkT5fwyBktqBSs-DwYLhod3nVplsGiljZpmkdrjQPEnIrn9dHsQhbp4bFir2F3ZXO3C1U4HFup0vHb5bsP2pJzpmGam5b04-v3k_d86PwEAAP__aZxoeA) the House wants to see. The college presidents --at Harvard, the University of Pennsylvania, and MIT--have been hit with calls [for their resignations](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FyhCAQgOGnwc4bdkHhCoo0dpc2pYOwnJtBdJCYubfPJHXqv_jn-3jMD8-Zy_Pdb-Ra2mcfGl80A_a2RzXrLrpEhKQ6cmAkSq2tHrvVGbMoHQbAZTQmpBTBoFLJyqQGuI_QsUOJClBaACnlcCOjU1wwjNHebRxJaEmR215vnzuXtlLKr_2iegv71mW3tnacQr0JnAROfgnmNwicjkonRyqtX329fI39V-GL6snt1W_c-oNKETiBhkFqAwKnrrp4fHPOfI5GaPncPOe_T_tX_RMAAP__6mxXcQ) after a ferocious backlash to their testimonies. Some politicians have called for an end to their institutions' tax-exempt status.
## McDonald's Launches New Chain for Snacking
McDonald's is planning a [new fast-food chain called CosMc's](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ_G7hzxswZcUHxNunztldaaXRJO2FjAJbq3P-XqK0fTjObjtt4w5XTc_-POvseyYujpyatUk5uUXmEkH5kV65G9tEIJAAdmfHg36zkSo5VWyllZaylIHXAjoRdneExeCaWlEk5KIcR8YQuRNhUMucWR4QEEU-qlXj5LOvqDY_4uT66XUPYx-0fvZxv0v0FdB3XF8-BXe6s31J5C5kFd90DlwExtqtw6flU8epsitj7FUmgy0sZtcfMSg7Gs0eEGQQKIKAKDhrF6Ol8p59SMHUDcd0z5N6D_ueMnAAD__1jRYCw) featuring customizable drinks and treats to appeal to afternoon snackers who now go to Dunkin's or Starbucks, a slice of the market worth $100 billion annually. The menu ranges from coffee and tea to frappes and slushies that can be customized with extra caffeine, kombucha, or a vitamin shot. It will also include breakfast sandwiches, snacks, and ice cream. [Here's a look at the menu.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGngS3WcVyBDgxdvKVrRwvDEVOBiWyaqm9ftXPmX__wfVyXayi17Lf30NiP3JcQR3nwovDiLqgXkslnZmQt2SsLCESOjNw8WQg2rjo7CgaAKUa7MmJCY7JdQRaPgFohOKUA4GViSzmtGE1yry4ZFgScyujH9NnLPjbO9ac_-Jhib7L6bYz7KfSbwFngHPvZ4vmXBM6N9y95-HT_LrWW01hBcGuh1P91PIX8BgAA__8m8Uln) The first CosMc test location will be in Bolingbrook, Illinois, near McDonald's corporate headquarters. The company plans to[ open ten others ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLsO2zAMAL9G3hTItOLH4KGLt3TtaDASZbPQI5DoBP37Ip0733CH-_XYH8iR8_ETE60Syo5O-E17D3rWMOy282sgAho6WvvJgLF2tmN3rvZp71PoQ-8RDVk0A-LgYLwvS3CwhI5XMDD0YOa-N8bcbzTZ4J_gRj8vsx9JWUOepdTb78JZTgrxT3lTvbmSurieIq-mhh8KNgWbnHRyjF-mYHMn5oPzoTFRZYcKNsqV3Zkoi4INqzTtrihXJQWbHexk50m70pJrOjlfMkbfdKU3YWw6Ub504NpECzXRsTgULrnpUKrO9NGVmuBVMYt2JTt6fTVdXf3rwzFyGydlzZGQ_yV28t-ZfwMAAP__YrJ50g)in the Midwest next year to test the concept.

name: Shift WA
subject: An Inslee whistleblower scandal
body:
Media outlets are now turning a blind eye to this first whistleblower scandal engulfing the Inslee Administration, with no follow up to the allegations that an economist was forced out for refusing to "jimmy" gas-price numbers to support the governor's carbon tax lies. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62558436:WvwBwCi6N:m:1:2610672541:CF28C44E2B817E26ED1495B8B0DD3F0B:r "Shift Washington")
---
|
Friends,

We hope this email finds you surviving the chaos of politicians scrambling for your wallet this December. **We know that liberal bigwigs, including gubernatorial wannabe Attorney General Bob Ferguson, are in a state of financial panic before the state 's elected official fundraising freeze kicks in at midnight tonight. **

The Democrats' desperation offers us a golden opportunity to highlight the far-Left's artful dance of taking money from their favorite special interests with one hand while doling out taxpayer dollars to those same friends with the other. It's a decades-long virtuous cycle they've engaged in for their financial - and electoral - advantage.

Of course, expecting mainstream reporters to ask tough questions about the Democrats' never-ending fundraising circus is a very long shot. **And now their reluctance to challenge Gov. Jay Inslee on his administration 's week-old whistleblower scandal is even more outrageous.**

Media outlets are now turning a blind eye to this first whistleblower scandal engulfing the Inslee Administration, with no follow up to the allegations that an economist was forced out for refusing to "jimmy" gas-price numbers to support the governor's carbon tax lies. The whistleblower's charge is as explosive as it is easy to believe, that "his career was ruined for his refusal to lie about how a new state policy, according to his mathematical calculations in early 2023, would jack up prices at the pump by 45 to 50 cents per gallon."

Unlike those media outlets, we at Shift WA have been highlighting the questions that this scandal has raised - and would be asked if reporters were interested in finding out the truth about Gov. Inslee's costly carbon tax. And, while the local media nap through this scandal, we're wide awake, doing what we do best - keeping you informed and holding the media's feet to the fire.

**[But our efforts rely entirely on the support of grassroots donors like you.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62558437:WvwBwCi6N:m:1:2610672541:CF28C44E2B817E26ED1495B8B0DD3F0B:r)**

**[Will you consider contributing $100, $50, or even $25 today to help us continue our work?](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62558437:WvwBwCi6N:m:1:2610672541:CF28C44E2B817E26ED1495B8B0DD3F0B:r)** Your contribution helps us stay in the game, on your side!

Thank you,

The Shift WA Team

| **The Pro-RCV Group Hired a “SPY” & “LIED” “STOLE” & Lost Anyway!!!****Imagine a scene straight out of a spy novel: The Pro-Ranked Choice Voting (RCV) group, in a twist of espionage, allegedly hired a 'spy' to infiltrate and disrupt the grassroots movement against RCV, and Stole 2 of our Petition Books, which we filed a Police Report on. But the plot thickens. In a bold move, the Pro-RCV group and their attorney attempted to persuade the State of Alaska to shut down our constitutional right to petition the government. Fortunately, the State stood firm and declined their request.****This isn’t fiction. It’s the reality of our ongoing battle to uphold our Republic in Alaska. We emerged victorious in this clash, but the war is far from over.****Our determination is stronger than ever, reflected in the over 34,000 signatures we've gathered so far, a number that continues to grow each day.****Our focus now turns to Anchorage Districts 14 through 18, where our efforts need to intensify. Below, you'll find an up-to-date chart detailing our progress and the work that lies ahead. Your support and participation are crucial. Join us in this fight to preserve our right to petition and shape the future of voting in Alaska.**

#### **PSA:**
#### **We submitted a formal complaint to APOC (Alaska Political Office Commission) concerning the actions of the Pro-RCV group in Alaska. While they have accused us of breaching various State Campaign Finance Laws, we assert that this group should also adhere to the same rules and regulations. Contrary to their portrayal, this organization is not grassroots and receives substantial funding from outside of Alaska. Our objective is to hold them responsible for their apparent hypocrisy and their attempts to intimidate and tarnish the image of Alaskans, their organizations, and families. Their efforts to suppress our movement against ranked choice voting should not go unnoticed, and they must answer for potentially breaking the same laws they accuse us of. It's concerning that these well-informed political activists, who have benefited from massive out-of-state donations for their ranked choice voting agenda and campaign finance law changes, manipulate the system to their advantage, expecting regular citizens to falter and then overwhelm them with financial and legal burdens. We trust that the State of Alaska will ensure that these laws are applied uniformly, calling this Pro-RCV group to account for any disregard of Alaskan laws and norms.**
#### **Please see the full 111 page complaint when it is made public by the news and APOC. All of this information is public information.**

____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dab209ee5361460e96f4e86352a57816&_e=k7vLocUaw8zU1sHR5KEuMciUcNu5VskfRsFKk96r7eGjZokI8Krct0zDElUl7KxpOOKSQSJRCUSQT8outreIXDU8cB-Hem4DGyA8adSgFO354WgywhoXV2cjj4rdR0F4mtHC4WKEGMKIBKJm7l1dWhm2RiT98IC-CetsoQMeL2_wte6XaaTFgaHW93NnGqNnl_P0OkVCJvEqMOIt7XUZoVC7Eo7VP-QaCcY5vC1L2BIDBjhSf4R0VnjuIDql9xZ4xqbzzsvo9dU4oFWUs2gH43PPKx3XpvFAc7chnLW0Sq0Q2xYChHfYPkJOK3zFBNZY8miIy8TeBWAVmxZY0X_uqTmaVAs5_SqraXm0pphCFeErV3M6Z59UfQ7SBNTVLM5t)
---
| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dab209ee5361460e96f4e86352a57816&_e=k7vLocUaw8zU1sHR5KEuMciUcNu5VskfRsFKk96r7eGjZokI8Krct0zDElUl7KxpOOKSQSJRCUSQT8outreIXDU8cB-Hem4DGyA8adSgFO354WgywhoXV2cjj4rdR0F4mtHC4WKEGMKIBKJm7l1dWhm2RiT98IC-CetsoQMeL2_wte6XaaTFgaHW93NnGqNnl_P0OkVCJvEqMOIt7XUZoRNzIiEiixOhZrCNNcFPtiAM_Wmr7ueinlnA0Xt6J-U3E2nYgFHT_HEFWNf34ChwI019GuEIimxYP4gz8o9J4yBJpXX0gkncdePGRNP2E6x4a-f8UaYStrB--3Jh9sxkURh-ja_Fr7D_4Ag056fLfsmbkSy24Vn911xrIIS5_39x).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I'm very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress

A federal appeals court blocked enforcement of portions of New York’s concealed carry law on Friday. name: Wes Moore
subject: Senator Tuberville
body:
Republican Senator Tommy Tuberville has singlehandedly held up military appointments for almost a year.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74795652/442680710/1666406465?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYTE4MzM5My1kYTk1LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GQ042JuDk0z4z4VoGaja60lhrFuNIN7ntEKDMzfohHY=)
Friend, Republican Senator Tommy Tuberville has _finally_ lifted his hold on most of the military promotions he’s been single-handedly delaying. **It’s been almost a year, friend.** Almost a year of Tuberville brazenly putting party over country, all to make a political statement rather than do his job. He has caused severe damage and compromised our national security. But Tuberville is _still_ holding military promotions for four-star generals. Anyone who has served knows that these leaders are crucial to overseeing key commands — and holding up these 11 four-star generals will continue to compromise our ability to keep our country safe. His actions have caused many of those serving our country unable to perform their duties as they were left in limbo for months. _It’s unacceptable._ When it comes to something as fundamental as keeping our country safe, it should never be about Democrats or Republicans. It should be about serving the American people. When my fellow soldiers were in distress on the front lines, nobody ever asked what party they belonged to. I’m grateful Sen. Tuberville’s blockade is partially over at last — but his partisan games with our national security should have never happened in the first place. **That’s not how we did things in the Army, it’s not how we do them in Maryland, and it’s not how we should do them in Congress, either.** Elevate, Wes Moore | **[Donate »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74795653/442680711/1674579916?refcode=em20231208&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYTE4MzM5My1kYTk1LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GQ042JuDk0z4z4VoGaja60lhrFuNIN7ntEKDMzfohHY=)**

name: Katia at United We Dream Action
subject: This is life while undocumented
body:
I live under the constant fear of detention or deportation to a country I’ve never been to. | | | Hi Peter — Being an undocumented student means that I have fewer opportunities than my peers. It’s harder for me to access financial aid, or health insurance, find a part time job, and travel — all things my friends can do without a second thought. I’m Katia, one of United We Dream Action’s leaders in Houston, Texas, and I want to share my story with you today. **So many aspects of daily life are impacted by your citizenship status.** A pathway to citizenship would allow my family to work in jobs that don’t exploit them. It would allow me to attend medical school and have the same opportunities as my other peers, regardless of citizenship status. Right now, my family and I live in fear of being taken advantage of by our employers over our undocumented status. **I live under the constant fear of detention or deportation to _a country I’ve never been to._** That’s why I’m fighting for a pathway to citizenship with United We Dream Action, and we need your support now more than ever. **We need citizenship NOW! Peter, I was asked this week about the growing number of Republicans members of Congress who plan to not seek re-election and the fact that some are citing a broken, dysfunctional system of governance. I hope those departing members who strive to see a Congress that prioritizes the American people will unite in their final days and speak out against those hindering progress. It would be beneficial for the future of America if they band together and push back against those unwilling to compromise and collaborate. In my opinion, part of the fundamental problem with Congress and those in Washington, D.C. right now is that the one thing that not nearly enough people do is to simply treat others with respect even when you disagree with them. This isn't a radical concept - in fact, it's absolutely essential for a functioning democracy! How else are our elected leaders going to find any compromise to get things done for the American people?

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=885%2E135344%2Eba39EU)

Team --
I know your inbox is FULL of emails right now from political campaigns and every store you’ve ever shopped at trying to get you to participate in their holiday deals.
Given the glut of emails, I wanted you to know this important point: unlike many political candidates, I write or edit every single email I send you. Including this one. Seriously. Here’s a photo of me editing this email, before it lands in your inbox:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231207-1-NOR&t=2&akid=885%2E135344%2Eba39EU)
Why do I write or edit every email? Because I never want our emails to feel like they are scamming, tricking you, or simply repeating what every other candidate sends. I will never use fake deadlines or sky-is-falling tactics. I will, instead, give you the truth, plain and simple, about the stakes of our race and the role your support plays in making sure we win this open Senate seat in Michigan.
In my three previous races, I've gone against corporate-backed GOP opponents and I've won. How? By having strong grassroots support -- from people like you contributing what you can. Contributions of $5 here, $50 there, really are the building blocks for the rest of our campaign.
And the truth is that this Senate race will be one of the most expensive in the country. Michigan is the _only open competitive Senate seat in the country,_ which means millions of dollars of national Republican money will pour into our state to fund the nasty attack ads on TV that we all hate.
[**So when I email you, it’s because contributions from these emails will help determine what our campaign can accomplish over the next year. So if you’re able, your support today would be a massive help.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231207-1-NOR&t=3&akid=885%2E135344%2Eba39EU)**
