# **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _2024 Indiana Republican Diversity Leadership Series Applications Closing Soon!_**
---
Friends, Hurry! Applications for the 2024 [Indiana Republican Diversity Leadership Series](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1d582fccc18667603947229f28c3afba/c3516b28ef9dc551c3d6b838967d376c/40313) (IRDLS) close at the end of the year. That means you only have **24 days **to throw your hat in the ring. When the IRDLS started in 2020, the goal was to increase engagement of under-represented Hoosiers in the Republican Party. Fast forward 3 years, and we have not only increased engagement, we had six IRDLS alumni on the ballot in 2023 and two were victorious! One example from this year's municipal election is IRDLS alum [Ronald Morrell Jr.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1d582fccc18667603947229f28c3afba/baa94bee7201bec0c3d6b838967d376c/40313), who became the first Black, Republican mayor in Indiana and the first Black mayor of his hometown, Marion, unseating a two term Democrat incumbent. **Ronald called the diversity series life changing and pivotal to his campaign**. Additionally, IRDLS alum Tiffanie Ditlevson was elected to the Fishers City Council. Ronald's and Tiffanie's successes are just the first of what will be a new standard for the IRDLS. Alumni of the diversity series will continue to develop their leadership skills and grow within our party. If you think you or someone you know has what it takes to be a leader of tomorrow, consider applying for the Indiana Republican Diversity Series [HERE,](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1d582fccc18667603947229f28c3afba/147372b0d85a6fbec3d6b838967d376c/40313) before the applications close after December 31st. We want to help you develop into the leader you are capable of being. The IRDLS will prepare you to lead and will grow the Indiana Republican Party to new heights!
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway
---
| |
# **Governor Eric Holcomb's Week in Review**
---
| |
# _Gov. Holcomb Announced the Launch of All Around Indiana_
---
---
| | [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1d582fccc18667603947229f28c3afba/dfb4ccb531f3af1fc3d6b838967d376c/40313)**Governor Eric Holcomb** , working alongside Imagine Indiana, launched [All Around Indiana](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1d582fccc18667603947229f28c3afba/bc2bbc5b1c3bf118c3d6b838967d376c/40313 "All Around Indiana"), a website that showcases our state’s unique charm through videos and testimonials. [All Around Indiana](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1d582fccc18667603947229f28c3afba/66855530e703a5cac3d6b838967d376c/40313) is a one-stop shop for videos that tell the Hoosier story in a vibrant and unique way. This series of videos and testimonials will allow the world to see some of the special attractions that make Indiana such a first-rate destination to live, work and play. **What he’s saying** : "As I talk to people around Indiana and the world about all we have to offer, I often found myself looking for something to show the person to better demonstrate what I was talking about.”, **Gov. Holcomb** shared in a press release. **What else happened this week?**[Gov. Holcomb](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1d582fccc18667603947229f28c3afba/6b08c72e90f85e25c3d6b838967d376c/40313) participated in a fireside chat for Engage Indiana, where the Governor discussed a number of topics related to Indiana's business professionals.
* To stay up-to-date, follow **Gov. Holcomb** on [Facebook](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1d582fccc18667603947229f28c3afba/9825956e17136ccec3d6b838967d376c/40313) or [Twitter](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1d582fccc18667603947229f28c3afba/7bacbf0094a44a55c3d6b838967d376c/40313).

---
|
---
# 📰 _Newsworthy_

---
| | Republican Mayor of Carmel Jim Brainard gave his final "[state of the city](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1d582fccc18667603947229f28c3afba/1841c43a1e715a0bc3d6b838967d376c/40313)" address after 28 years of exemplary service to his city. Under Brainard's leadership, Carmel has become a nationally recognized [top city to live](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1d582fccc18667603947229f28c3afba/70a2fd9c2fdd92d9c3d6b838967d376c/40313) in in the United States. Mayor Brainard was also honored with multiple awards, an unveiling of a portrait that will hang in Carmel's city hall, and he was presented with one of the state's highest honors, the Sagamore of the Wabash, by surprise guest former Governor Mitch Daniels. Mayor Brainard's final state of the city and the recognition he received this week is a testimony to the incredible leadership he has provided. Mayor Brainard also took a moment to recognize newly elected Republican Mayor Sue Finkam. Brainard praised Mayor-Elect Finkam and said he looks forward to what is yet to come. [Mayor-Elect Finkam](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1d582fccc18667603947229f28c3afba/2a6fba5bc3b312d7c3d6b838967d376c/40313) was one of many successful Republican candidates in the 2023 municipal elections last month. She will look to continue Mayor Brainard's legacy and make sure Carmel remains the standard for Mayors across the country, through Republican principles and leadership.
---

|

# 📱 _News You Can Use_

---
**Governor Eric Holcomb** [met](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1d582fccc18667603947229f28c3afba/9e17c1b29e02743ac3d6b838967d376c/40313) with mayors from all over Indiana. **Lt. body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time
188d92cdddd40f90da47bc74ea2ba8fb
This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/u90D1CGgrYsk01aoox3EaQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRnVeXGP0SoaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjMxMjA4VwNzcGNCCmVrgzpzZdmgqKtSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/u90D1CGgrYsk01aoox3EaQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRnVeXGP0SoaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjMxMjA4VwNzcGNCCmVrgzpzZdmgqKtSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/u90D1CGgrYsk01aoox3EaQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRnVeXGP0SoaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjMxMjA4VwNzcGNCCmVrgzpzZdmgqKtSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Restore Our Nation

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights Hides the corruption of the ruling class Attacks those with traditional viewpoints That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice. Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat. A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is reaching and teaching millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. | | Well, who would’ve thunk it? I guess the First Amendment applies to Christians as well. The Capitol Christmas tree has been accepting ornaments from the public for ages, but the rules used to say no [religious symbols](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2ab10512e686444cbc110ba2a77a0047&_e=2Ogl3JfsVgGKiOkI2qZoMleOtm-5p11SjTwwBgszOaIptu2E0odqUx_nWjgl0CovxQg2wv0g0QJW0XSLPGOLpVg0NPJC-luB2Ilp5nTfJceNf14hHgJer5i-3_7e1OdX4zIgDMoFhBwl14peVrPSfwiTtyU4waMtmt2NGrnxhCagcE2OabwqawkLX4GhZTJzvo2SJlzSeJTdm-LJ8PNwgWmtKAYiv7huVDuD5KYe1wWrBslBLSkikhZtWBJU0rncK600yfgF_bbt06AX1_tPlvNL-YB4NMbH9J8dOpaXcPb4HnVremLpoanged85fQrx) are allowed. That meant no nativity scenes or anything of the sort. But things took a turn this year, and I praise the Lord for it. The ban on religious symbols for "the People's Tree" has been [lifted](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2ab10512e686444cbc110ba2a77a0047&_e=2Ogl3JfsVgGKiOkI2qZoMg6LcpMFIVYEWDvG3yihLp98exX7MqWfM9PpWuUXGYl9HrCnx8a18TWbkVzqVMU0iI1xqpLKVGjkpUQwQjt6fpWCMUrn_bum70t_wmzC3mRHtdp6xqfibGLUsq3JMCXjutAQbbSZkOMATXZZ965qfCO_yeS8T_Td8GlOCQg3hPoTNNYtd-1c1RO6xcUCjNmrQdpAfp4dhFGZjAShVv48Lk48ozYBBUHYnpYhZXBg6oazHhz6bGw6eOAEcm47l8rxrCmqmRBkmuoe1ZVxQJ5IC0AAaTQB4jttCBpb4IR2rDVW). So, now we can truly embrace the essence of Christmas and ensure that Christ remains a central part of our celebrations. _It is his birthday after all..._ This First Amendment reminder couldn’t have come at a better time as our nation deals with a real mess of antisemitism, and it's downright sickening to see it [spreading like wildfire.](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2ab10512e686444cbc110ba2a77a0047&_e=2Ogl3JfsVgGKiOkI2qZoMrnnjf7OHuPjnzoHiyNBpmiLYHr1y_gOAtWQ_s-Ld9hjL5-7LTab8hO1GcvGVJnLHzNF_eoaivUAcNTcK2PXA3XNaqHOKuSu1AKOiSWD85rn0vV0D012AEP-n5_Z0ILd5ph9Zm6GO-IrEYT7aiHxGTCxJGF9hgiWf4n7SUYIfv-RKv_2q2H3XNggWDV51K_Hn_vCTFGn_Xy3ZvqDJNNVl-RBmuTXZoNL5YIOvohmHo0JnDLBaQRctaS-mkgGmAWw0aDOWG6iCBacdnVyYXYNrkU%3D) Now, in case you missed the memo, the big-shot presidents from Harvard, MIT, and UPenn paraded themselves up on the Hill just the other day. They were given the floor to talk about the rising [antisemitism](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2ab10512e686444cbc110ba2a77a0047&_e=2Ogl3JfsVgGKiOkI2qZoMps_llykW2isnB5rNMy8xdXYGndxtwRwrMtBrhYjIbdwD6yQLTWzX72HIsQzJRG-Ex5099Ti86GkdASfYJFNezBGogie_hB1ltQpoZhZc10M3DiNsKy65dpMZXuI4E08HYFir2oqVhZGbzbUMhA9BHgolz5Gpeq6G7UlH768EiUzIIEWucKFHC-IeAB7P4fVvymhds_svW4G-5DbaYPCt1Q%3D) on their campuses. Among the many [outrageous things we heard](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2ab10512e686444cbc110ba2a77a0047&_e=2Ogl3JfsVgGKiOkI2qZoMps_llykW2isnB5rNMy8xdXgjDgttvKL5AEj2vfxRQMfNi7JpnuFTXQOy7iBHvc_dzw72a8NdjJIpaRAEwdiMuL42cD5Tm4UMzYUC2detctW-SRUp4Yd5AWugD07Bh2Y0xbchux1h0oFWnMz0NQSGgs8KOIfxgAT8Oe2EZrgDtYf89vGatk5oL1OTVTbgUUbM-d4vc81alIb2siOdsPkK7dAzheyRA1J3X3NFvu6evDnXvX2HpIUXzKdabiWrN7oB_0H487JuuWLMEGuzuSVgxHSP1Zm57XT0accvPavT_zCGdhpuugEtiZrSoliQ6gSkQ%3D%3D), their responses when asked repeatedly if calling for the genocide of Jews constitutes harassment were a disgrace. "We have heard chants which can be antisemitic depending on the context when calling for the elimination of the Jewish people," MIT President Sally Kornbluth said. _CAN BE?_ These higher education institutions already [cost an arm and a leg](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2ab10512e686444cbc110ba2a77a0047&_e=2Ogl3JfsVgGKiOkI2qZoMkHuwTMsN2oz5gWXhAwJWgc64sK44Qm6abMh1JPUWmdIZxDGLKC0xf6ryWYhFNgv5TMgo-CkXia5CMBvwM95N2QTb_nWmb5efq5NU2PZzJ689_qUggHA3TltzDrqgXrFs8rwIjggaKI7BzEGmJUw1GId0ZSVx8Xc5GjXVh32L-itBVOh1LAI5wCXVtIudOcL1bqdHsETb5tD-JK6sG4DlGWqkLfyO-Ns8GRetILEupFJhvboweY1GUkM7NLADlcf2Q%3D%3D), but to make matters worse, young Jewish folks now have to pay the price of harassment and threats. Is this not America? Antisemitism on our college campuses (or anywhere for that matter) is unacceptable. This country was founded on the basic principles of religious freedom for all. These [woke institutions](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2ab10512e686444cbc110ba2a77a0047&_e=2Ogl3JfsVgGKiOkI2qZoMobyO4XHmLCytQzVB9Mhu8XRtbIhZcV1s5XbBCbHZQ8gpWd_evxcomJ0H49G5BcamXVH4FbfkOLIz60XAfHknBE7y2gzqoiQz-ax-nEvO1LnfHhjRW3VUi2nQPYhWsTIwE0a13ZWBCBOGSSMBo8K8qFghyQNV9ZWuQ2KZT6mjBkY6BFEHfVbwKvzMef-oheab35blIvj5DsKsBIOGvyn-Ooa3_Vn7FEPn6gH7NXGss632lTVmCvssNMcvP2sHvSIUPJ4pOaIkZBTW50OVWaaY_u0hJKUnzdFlWFgK_fuX2cN) have bent over backward for every other so-called marginalized group, but now they’re ready to stick their heads in the sand when our Jewish family, friends, and neighbors need them most. If that’s the plan, they better be in it for the long haul because I know I speak for many of us when I say we’re not letting this one go. We will not rest until these students feel safe. As our Jewish friends celebrate Hanukkah over the next several days, there has never been a better time to renew our commitment to standing with them and defending their right to exist in some dadgum peace. Chag sameach to all of my dear friends and colleagues who partake in the Festival of Lights.

| | This week marks the 82nd anniversary of the attack on Pearl Harbor, an event that served as the catalyst for America entering into World War II. As I reflect on this pivotal moment in U.S. history, I feel compelled to tip my hat to the courageous folks who served during that era. Thank you to the brave men and women, like my dad, who are rightly called the Greatest Generation. There is no doubt that those who dedicated themselves to defending freedom left a legacy that will continue to inspire generations to come. To all those who have served or continue to serve today, we see you. Your selflessness does not go unnoticed, and we appreciate your dedication to safeguarding the liberty our great nation was founded on.

Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

subject: Campaign Updates December 8!

body:
ICYMI
| | | |
---
---
| Maria's Community Champions
---
| | |
---|---
Earning the confidence and support of community members, leaders, and business people is what distinguishes Maria Montero--she reflects the people, values, and work ethic of the 7th Congressional District in Pennsylvania.

This week, we are pleased to share the support of Nicole Romanishin. Nicole's family goes back generations in Northampton County's Slate Belt as proud farmers and concerned citizens. Nicole brings that same kind of work ethic and commitment to everything she does and is an involved leader. Nicole and the people of the Slate Belt are the quintessential examples of small town American values....
just like the ones Maria grew up with in Summit Hill, a small town located in the coal regions of Carbon County.

While growing up in Summit Hill family, faith, and friendships were at the core of Maria's development. She grew up surrounded by family, trusting in people, relying on neighbors, attending church services (Mass), volunteering to pitch-in, creating life-long friendships, and being outside playing in every sport possible in the fresh, clean mountain air. Though her parents had shared custody, the time spent between Allentown and Summit Hill was starkly different. The street smarts one needs to learn in a city like Allentown, came much later in her life, probably for the best. Most everything she needed to know, for which she is most thankful, she learned in her small hometown. Maria does believe in the American Dream and that better days lay ahead for America...

At the Federal level, elected officials can start righting the ship by:

* Securing the Border to reduce crime and stop dangerous drugs
* Supporting law enforcement & veterans for they lay down their lives for us
* Lowering taxes so we keep more of our hard-earned income
* Cutting through onerous regulations on small businesses
* Increasing manufacturing and developing our energy resources here in PA

It is crystal clear to Maria, we should empower local communities to decide what is best for them and the federal government's power should be limited.

In Maria's run to be your next congresswoman, earning support from salt of the earth folks, like Nicole and others in the Slate Belt, is humbling; yet the momentum our team is building is energizing, thank you!

| Dear Fellow Patriot,

I'm reaching out to you today with an exceptional, limited-time opportunity. An opportunity to reinforce the cornerstones that define our nation - life, liberty, community, and faith - and to heal the uncertainty and division that is currently gripping us.

For too long, we've watched as individuals who depart from our founding principles lead our nation into waters filled with uncertainty. The consequences? Our economy is faltering, our culture is eroding, and the heart of our great republic - respect for life and liberty - is under relentless attack. And that's exactly why I'm inviting you to become part of our profoundly significant mission. [By making a generous year-end gift](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6ilt2r7v9qgk10ftv5ipriv8t9l3q07qflvj48o_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c1hm9pr4slh2bs), you can champion conservative solutions to our nation's most pressing challenges.

The year 2024 is pivotal for the conservative movement, and the good news is, there has never been a better moment to support these efforts.

Right now, your gift to ACI will be automatically doubled by our $100,000 Year-End Matching Gift Challenge. That's correct - every dollar given will be matched, allowing your contribution to have double its normal impact in restoring our guiding values.

To rise to this challenge, please make a year-end gift while this exclusive opportunity is still available. You can make your gift using this secure link: [https://secure.americancornerstone.org/cye-2023](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9vaetvi7e2a1645fppj25uo5nk166ondt5iqc0g_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c1hm9pr4slh2bs).

Thank you for standing with me and the American Cornerstone Institute, so together, we can reestablish America's enduring principles and secure a brighter future for not just us, but future generations.

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

body:
There are over 40,000 oil wells in CA that leak and pollute our communities.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=34421%2E3422442%2EnUr9J-)
Derek,
Did you catch this? ⬇️
[](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-big-oil-cost/?source=EMAO23_1_OIL_20231208_V1_F&akid=34421%2E3422442%2EnUr9J-)
This is the classic Big Oil playbook: pollute, profit, and leave taxpayers to clean up the mess. I wouldn’t let my kids make a mess and then walk away, and I’ll hold oil companies to the same standard. [**I have a new proposal requiring oil companies to front the cost of clean-up. Can you sign on to my petition in support of this new rule?**](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-big-oil-cost/?source=EMAO23_1_OIL_20231208_V1_F&akid=34421%2E3422442%2EnUr9J-)
[Sign On](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-big-oil-cost/?source=EMAO23_1_OIL_20231208_V1_F&akid=34421%2E3422442%2EnUr9J-)
There are over 40,000 oil wells in California that leak and pollute our communities, even as they've sat inactive for years. We need to take urgent action, and taxpayers shouldn’t have to foot the bill.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

A new poll from Data for Progress once again shows that a majority of ALL
voters, including 76% of Democrats, support a ceasefire and think we
should only send military funding to Israel if they meet human rights
conditions.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231208.0IW7Ce&refcode=em20231208-32235&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=32235%2E1203867%2E6CWR8Q ]Data for Progress poll results

There may be division in our country, but it’s clear that most people
stand united against genocide and the U.S. government’s financial support
for it.

Despite the overwhelming support for a permanent ceasefire and the release
of all Israeli and Palestinian hostages, only 11% of Congress has stood on
the right side of history on this issue, including every member of the
Squad.

Thanks to the courageous leadership of our Justice Democrats incumbents
like Cori Bush, Rashida Tlaib, Jamaal Bowman, Summer Lee, Ilhan Omar,
Ayanna Pressley, and AOC, in addition to the hard work of pro-peace
organizers across the country, the momentum for a ceasefire continues to
grow day by day.

We started with only 18 cosponsors of Cori and Rashida’s ceasefire
resolution; today, there are 60 members of Congress backing it, and
organizations like the United Auto Workers and Doctors Without Borders
have joined us.

It’s clear where the people stand on this issue, and how strong of a grip
Republican billionaire-funded, anti-Palestinian groups like AIPAC have on
both sides of the aisle in Washington.

Our bloc of young, Black and brown, working-class, progressive champions
are facing unprecedented attacks in these months leading up to the
Democratic primary elections, including $100 million in AIPAC spending
against them. We need to have their backs.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231208.0IW7Ce&refcode=em20231208-32235&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=32235%2E1203867%2E6CWR8Q ]Please, if you’re able to, pitch in a grassroots donation of
$3 or more today to help re-elect Justice Democrats
incumbents and keep our progressive movement alive in 2024 →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231208.0IW7Ce&refcode=em20231208-32235&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=32235%2E1203867%2E6CWR8Q ]Contribute $3

Outside groups funded by GOP mega-donors think they can defeat us next
year and maintain the status quo. Let’s show them what we’re made of.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1022&akid=32235%2E1203867%2E6CWR8Q ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=32235%2E1203867%2E6CWR8Q ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

| Peter,

Today, I officially filed for re-election in North Carolina’s 4th Congressional District. It has been an honor to serve the people of the fourth district this year in Congress. When I ran for Congress last year, I did so after decades of public service and a deep commitment to my community. Thanks to your support, I became the first Black woman to represent North Carolina’s 4th Congressional District.

In the past year, I’ve worked to make sure my time in Congress is spent wisely.
* I currently have three voting rights bills in committee aimed at protecting our voting rights and defending our democracy.

* As a member of the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force, I’m working across the aisle to pass lifesaving gun violence prevention legislation.

* And every day, I’m working to protect reproductive freedom and ensure safe, legal, and accessible abortion services for all.

With dysfunction at an all-time high in Washington, it is more important than ever to have result-driven leaders in Congress. 2023 in Review: Bipartisan Infrastructure Bill
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74815945/442731664/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NzQ2OWY4OS1lZjk1LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p9cui-EPqmtaLS6Kndc1g7eAUvg49zueiucOwtUTfoo=&emci=9456177e-7b94-ee11-8925-002248223f36&emdi=47469f89-ef95-ee11-8925-002248223f36&ceid=9494239)
---

| | Previously, I wrote to you about how Donald Trump fought against our bipartisan infrastructure law two years ago, threatening members of his own party if they went along with President Biden's plan. **Here are just a few things he did not want to happen for the people of Washington state. Since November 2021, we have seen:**
* $3.6 _billion_ in investments for major road and bridge projects, including extensive safety upgrades.
* $366 million for clean drinking water investment.
* $219 million for our lifeline ports and waterways, a big part of Washington State's economic engine.
* $753 million to update our public transit infrastructure and systems.
* $255 for airport modernization.

These are**common sense**** _investments_** that Donald Trump opposed, family-wage _jobs_ and safety improvements he did not want for our friends and neighbors. They represent a major wave in _green infrastructure_ he does not value. And it means utter essentials like access to clean drinking water, which often go overlooked by people like him in positions of privilege. Donald Trump and his most loyal Republicans are campaigning on taking things _away_ from the American people — rights, choices, access to things like health care and voting — that should be basics. President Biden and Democrats? We believe in creating jobs and paving the way to a greener, cleaner future**.** As I have said before, a great nation invests in its own people, in their health, safety, and families. clean_body: 2023 in Review: Bipartisan Infrastructure Bill | | | | Previously, I wrote to you about how Donald Trump fought against our bipartisan infrastructure law two years ago, threatening members of his own party if they went along with President Biden's plan. Here are just a few things he did not want to happen for the people of Washington state. Since November 2021, we have seen: $3.6 billion in investments for major road and bridge projects, including extensive safety upgrades. $366 million for clean drinking water investment. $219 million for our lifeline ports and waterways, a big part of Washington State's economic engine. $753 million to update our public transit infrastructure and systems. $255 for airport modernization. These arecommon sense** investments that Donald Trump opposed, family-wage jobs and safety improvements he did not want for our friends and neighbors. They represent a major wave in green infrastructure he does not value. And it means utter essentials like access to clean drinking water, which often go overlooked by people like him in positions of privilege. Donald Trump and his most loyal Republicans are campaigning on taking things away from the American people — rights, choices, access to things like health care and voting — that should be basics. President Biden and Democrats? We believe in creating jobs and paving the way to a greener, cleaner future. As I have said before, a great nation invests in its own people, in their health, safety, and families. This infrastructure law was exactly that. This is exactlywhy I serve: because America is a sum of its parts, of the great places and people that have come together under an idea that we can be better and stronger together. Investing in those places and people seems like a smart choice to me, an absolute no-brainer. And it is why I am so excited about the upcoming 2024 campaign to take back the House and re-elect President Biden: because of what we have already accomplished, and what more we can continue to achieve together. ---
| | Dear Peter,

One of the advantages of servings as both Chairman of the Washington State Republican Party and an elected State Representative in Olympia, is having thorough experiences and analysis in every corner of our great state. Providing a clear understanding of the key issues facing Washingtonians - and the solutions needed to solve our shared challenges.

One disadvantage, in my capacity as legislator,**I am prohibited** from directly making any campaign fundraising asks during the legislative "freeze" period, **which starts TOMORROW.**

_I am legally able to fundraise for the State Party_ during this period, and while there are other chairs who are also elected officials across the country who do so, I will not be. We all know **Democrats and sections of the** **media here in Washington State would love nothing more than to create a false scandal around their favorite conservative target, me.

_You will still be hearing from me_ -** our critical work at the WAGOP will still continue** full steam ahead **over the next couple months - there is plenty of information and action items that I will be updating you with as we move forward. Unfortunately, **this will be the last opportunity I have for the next few months to ask you personally to fund our vital work.**

**[_To help fill the fundraising gap from now until the end of the legislative session, will you click the button below and make a year-end contribution for $25, $50, or even $100 to our operations today?_](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=cc97cfe625&e=6a281f566d)**

Please consider making it your very best contribution this year as we will need every ounce of grassroots activism during the 2024 Legislative session.
---
| [Make an end of year contribution to the Republican Party](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=73eaf36e56&e=6a281f566d "Make an end of year contribution to the Republican Party")
---
| I know that might be a lot to ask during the holiday season, but **we must take the fight directly to the Democrats starting in January** and I know you expect us to do so.

You can already tell how scared the Democrats are by the six initiatives that are on pace to qualify for the 2024 legislative session.

Our GOP teams will be there at the beginning of session making sure voters know Democrats have these common-sense initiatives in hand, ready to pass into law. We will be there throughout the legislative session to remind voters that **Democrats are refusing** to pass these initiatives into law. And we will be there after the session ends to tell voters how**Democrats failed to act** \- and that not only will we pass these initiatives at the ballot box in November, but we will replace the Democrat legislators who failed to act.

Along with efforts to support common-sense initiatives signed by citizens, **the State Party will also have the task** of mobilizing grassroots conservatives to register opinions on bills, contact legislators who are on the wrong side of common-sense legislation, and once-again making sure voters across the state know Democrats are the ones responsible for the failures of our state.

**Without your vital support,** our teams cannot carry out this important work during the legislative session

| | Republicans in Washington State need to win the early battles in January if we want to win the close races in November. We will do it as aggressively as possible. And in doing so, **we will start winning again** come November 2024.

Please support our efforts today and let's head into 2024 united and ready to work. Thank you!

Sincerely,

Jim Walsh

subject: I want your opinion on religious liberty
body:

| Dear Fellow American,

I am reaching out today because I believe that you, like me, are concerned about the increasing trend of legal persecution against Americans who wish to live their lives according to their faith. Our cornerstones of faith, liberty, community, and life form the bedrock of our great nation, and we need your help to maintain them. [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/J5lZ2tyCQfUHx509_YGZoA~~/AARclAA~~) From a high school football coach in Washington who lost his job for praying on the field (KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT), to a Colorado baker hauled through the legal system multiple times for not wanting to bake a cake that violated his religious convictions (MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION), we can't ignore the gradual erosion of religious freedom in America.

That's why I created the American Cornerstone Institute to advocate for commonsense solutions to these issues and to strengthen the bonds that keep our nation united. But we can't do it alone.

**We need your voice.**

I want to personally invite you to participate in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**You can share your thoughts using this secure link:[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/J5lZ2tyCQfUHx509_YGZoA~~/AARclAA~~)**

Your responses are confidential and will be used solely towards furthering our advocacy efforts.

[Please, take a few minutes of your time to complete the survey.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/J5lZ2tyCQfUHx509_YGZoA~~/AARclAA~~) Your input is vital in helping us understand the scope of these issues and develop impactful strategies to counteract them.

Your opinion truly matters. Together, we can ensure that religious liberty continues to thrive as an integral part of our American society.

For Liberty,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

Peter –
This week I filed for re-election to continue serving the Second Congressional District of Texas in the U.S. House of Representatives. I also condemned the despicable antisemitism displayed by the presidents of some of America's top educational institutions and again called for action from the Biden Administration to secure the southern border.
As I launch my re-election campaign for Congress, I need the support of committed patriots like you from across the country to ensure I have the resources necessary to win. If you're able to contribute even a small donation to my campaign, I would greatly appreciate it as I continue to fight for you in Congress on the issues that matter most. You can donate at this link:

| As always, thank you for your continued support. Now, here's your brief.
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| HERE'S WHY I'M RUNNING FOR RE-ELECTION
---
| |
---
| I recently filed for re-election to represent the Second Congressional District of Texas in the U.S. House of Representatives.
Many are choosing to retire from Congress this year, which is frankly understandable. This year has been a particularly tumultuous one in Congress. We've seen chaos and infighting. The perverse incentive structure in American politics makes it more profitable and rewarding for politicians to sow division and generate fame for themselves rather than working on behalf of their constituents. All of this distracts from the real work in front of Congress for the American people - securing the southern border, reining in inflation, addressing crime in our communities, and stopping the scourge of fentanyl.
But, at least to me, that is all the more reason to remain in the fight. Our country desperately needs leadership at this moment - serious legislators who are committed to doing the hard work of policy making in Congress. That is what I've tried to provide - real leadership - to my constituents and my country since I was elected to the House five years ago.
I'm working hard on the Energy and Commerce Committee to fight for American energy independence and our vital oil and gas industry. As Chairman of the Cartel Task Force, I'm fighting back against the Mexican drug cartels who are killing tens of thousands of Americans with fentanyl. And I'm working every day to find solutions to the rampant illegal immigration crisis caused by Joe Biden's open border policies.
I take this work and my mission to grow the conservative movement seriously and I want to continue that work in Congress. It is an honor to represent the good people of the Second District of Texas since 2019, and I hope I will continue to have your support as I seek re-election.
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| DESPICABLE ANTISEMITISM FROM IVY LEAGUE PRESIDENTS
---
| [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h_cZR01K8hnZyFSAgbk8pp4iIZZqXD-Htg0HqszXtEafxw0Zu987inIs_T6G-lWlo8AYYe4Nnk0lUSYchbBIb9YXHEv11C0sHAgP3Jc0ISrsUnawjHpPtUvX_KVTHcP-8GseD3cTc3ujaJMogteqfMBTm0NE7HPxEEYGAvKImuQe5ieHec6Uo_ERQDA4gpf_&c=JiESD9Q5bRsK10RgVsoI1M6ZpgI31eXJG10RKd0SXiqmQTa5lfHOrg==&ch=mdeGHbr_LIYhz2fLWaIFt8R_hHJzNwwWZe5FYlLKPqIPwidTm_sc1w==)
---
| Harvard President Claudine Gay spoke at an Education and Workforce Committee hearing this week on "Holding Campus Leaders Accountable, and Confronting Antisemitism."
President Gay was asked several times if calling for the genocide of Jews violates the Harvard code of conduct. Her response? "It depends on the context."
The next day Harvard posted a statement on her behalf, explaining that people were "confused" by her testimony and that she in fact condemns calls for genocide against Jews. So why was President Gay unable to say this at the hearing? Did it really take universal outrage to admit that genocide is wrong?
This is a disgusting display of blatant antisemitism. And it wasn't just the president of Harvard. The presidents of MIT and Penn were asked the same question during the hearing, and every single one of them refused to answer this basic question.
Now they are all rightfully under fire for their despicable antisemitism. They should not be given the opportunity to resign - they should be removed from their positions in disgrace. Antisemitism is rampant on college campuses across America because the leaders of these universities refuse to stand up to the radicals pushing this vile garbage. We must hold them accountable.
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| BIDEN CONTINUES TO FAIL AMERICANS AT OUR SOUTHERN BORDER
---
| [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h_cZR01K8hnZyFSAgbk8pp4iIZZqXD-Htg0HqszXtEafxw0Zu987inIs_T6G-lWlVVCJ2bX0Rzubl48sGqGepOH0E73cwsnIp_fclCTiqVpLEGduTdmimlpdbb_rwuKZ5ZGQL9csrf3lEjhQtT6zNvwipo8V26cwp1Mx8vpzmNBcelo77nkFc9wGe3oADmAd&c=JiESD9Q5bRsK10RgVsoI1M6ZpgI31eXJG10RKd0SXiqmQTa5lfHOrg==&ch=mdeGHbr_LIYhz2fLWaIFt8R_hHJzNwwWZe5FYlLKPqIPwidTm_sc1w==)
---
| Joe Biden had an opportunity to show that he - for once - took the ongoing crisis at the southern border seriously. There is a simple deal on the table in Congress right now - make basic policy changes at the southern border to rein in illegal immigration in exchange for additional American support for Ukraine in their war against Russia.
Instead of taking this deal, which would achieve two goals at the same time, Joe Biden displayed his typical partisanship and ambivalence to the national security crisis he has created at our southern border.
Joe Biden called basic border security measures "extreme partisan border policies."
So, what is Joe Biden calling extreme? Here are some of the things we are asking for:

* Stopping the abuse of our asylum laws to discourage migrants from making bogus asylum claims.

* More tools to stop the flow of illegal immigrants and deadly drugs like fentanyl into our country.

* Enforcing the immigration laws already on the books that he is CONSTITUTIONALLY REQUIRED TO EXECUTE.

Does any of that sound "extreme" or "partisan" to you? No, of course not. This is the easiest deal imaginable for Joe Biden and Congressional Democrats to make, but they care too much about maintaining their open border policies to make it.
They are confirming what we already knew: Democrat leaders in Washington are exclusively responsible for an open border that is threatening American sovereignty and security.

I also condemned the despicable antisemitism displayed by the presidents of some of America's top educational institutions and again called for action from the Biden Administration to secure the southern border. As I launch my re-election campaign for Congress, I need the support of committed patriots like you from across the country to ensure I have the resources necessary to win. If you're able to contribute even a small donation to my campaign, I would greatly appreciate it as I continue to fight for you in Congress on the issues that matter most. You can donate at this link: | | | == | As always, thank you for your continued support. Now, here's your brief. | | | | | | | | HERE'S WHY I'M RUNNING FOR RE-ELECTION | | | I recently filed for re-election to represent the Second Congressional District of Texas in the U.S. House of Representatives. Many are choosing to retire from Congress this year, which is frankly understandable. This year has been a particularly tumultuous one in Congress. We've seen chaos and infighting. The perverse incentive structure in American politics makes it more profitable and rewarding for politicians to sow division and generate fame for themselves rather than working on behalf of their constituents. All of this distracts from the real work in front of Congress for the American people - securing the southern border, reining in inflation, addressing crime in our communities, and stopping the scourge of fentanyl. But, at least to me, that is all the more reason to remain in the fight. Our country desperately needs leadership at this moment - serious legislators who are committed to doing the hard work of policy making in Congress. That is what I've tried to provide - real leadership - to my constituents and my country since I was elected to the House five years ago. I'm working hard on the Energy and Commerce Committee to fight for American energy independence and our vital oil and gas industry. As Chairman of the Cartel Task Force, I'm fighting back against the Mexican drug cartels who are killing tens of thousands of Americans with fentanyl. And I'm working every day to find solutions to the rampant illegal immigration crisis caused by Joe Biden's open border policies. I take this work and my mission to grow the conservative movement seriously and I want to continue that work in Congress. It is an honor to represent the good people of the Second District of Texas since 2019, and I hope I will continue to have your support as I seek re-election. | | | | | | | | DESPICABLE ANTISEMITISM FROM IVY LEAGUE PRESIDENTS | == | Harvard President Claudine Gay spoke at an Education and Workforce Committee hearing this week on "Holding Campus Leaders Accountable, and Confronting Antisemitism." President Gay was asked several times if calling for the genocide of Jews violates the Harvard code of conduct. Her response? "It depends on the context." The next day Harvard posted a statement on her behalf, explaining that people were "confused" by her testimony and that she in fact condemns calls for genocide against Jews. So why was President Gay unable to say this at the hearing? Did it really take universal outrage to admit that genocide is wrong? This is a disgusting display of blatant antisemitism. And it wasn't just the president of Harvard. The presidents of MIT and Penn were asked the same question during the hearing, and every single one of them refused to answer this basic question. Now they are all rightfully under fire for their despicable antisemitism. They should not be given the opportunity to resign - they should be removed from their positions in disgrace. Antisemitism is rampant on college campuses across America because the leaders of these universities refuse to stand up to the radicals pushing this vile garbage. We must hold them accountable. | | | | | | BIDEN CONTINUES TO FAIL AMERICANS AT OUR SOUTHERN BORDER | == | Joe Biden had an opportunity to show that he - for once - took the ongoing crisis at the southern border seriously. There is a simple deal on the table in Congress right now - make basic policy changes at the southern border to rein in illegal immigration in exchange for additional American support for Ukraine in their war against Russia. Instead of taking this deal, which would achieve two goals at the same time, Joe Biden displayed his typical partisanship and ambivalence to the national security crisis he has created at our southern border. Joe Biden called basic border security measures "extreme partisan border policies." So, what is Joe Biden calling extreme? Here are some of the things we are asking for: Stopping the abuse of our asylum laws to discourage migrants from making bogus asylum claims. More tools to stop the flow of illegal immigrants and deadly drugs like fentanyl into our country. * Enforcing the immigration laws already on the books that he is CONSTITUTIONALLY REQUIRED TO EXECUTE. Does any of that sound "extreme" or "partisan" to you? No, of course not. disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=4686%2E5257348%2EA2V0J3 ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek, Donald
Trump just vowed in an exclusive Sean Hannity Fox News town hall that he
would be a dictator on “day one.”

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=dec2023_abs_em.181qVM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC30_20231208_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=4686%2E5257348%2EA2V0J3 ]Clip of Donald Trump speaking at an exclusive town hall on Fox News

Hannity: “Under no circumstances, you are promising America tonight, you would
never abuse power as retribution against anybody.”

Trump: “Except for day one...I love this guy. He says, ‘you’re not gonna be a
dictator, are you?’ I said, no, no, no — other than day one...After that, I’m not
a dictator.”

Let me tell you this,
Derek: If
we allow Trump to make it to day one, it will already be too late.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=dec2023_abs_em.181qVM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC30_20231208_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=1005&akid=4686%2E5257348%2EA2V0J3 ]We can’t let it get that far. Derek,
all of the alarm bells are going off. Our
democracy is quite literally on the line. I need your urgent support. Rush
a contribution of
$3 or
more to my campaign now to help me stand up for our democracy, win this
Senate race, and defeat Trump.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=dec2023_abs_em.181qVM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC30_20231208_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=1006&akid=4686%2E5257348%2EA2V0J3 ]DONATE
$3

It’s been nearly four years since I stood in the well of the Senate as the
lead impeachment manager of Trump’s Senate trial and told the senators:

Trump has compromised our elections, and he will do so again. You will not
change him. You cannot constrain him. He is who he is. Truth matters
little to him. What’s right matters even less, and decency matters not at
all.

You can’t trust this president to do the right thing. Not for one minute, not
for one election, not for the sake of our country. You just can’t. He will not
change and you know it.

I wish the past few years had proved different, but every word I said on
the Senate floor has been proven right.

Since that day, our democracy has suffered a deadly insurrection at the
Capitol and witnessed the first-ever indictments of an American president.

This problem isn’t going away. It isn’t going to resolve itself. And our
democracy is not guaranteed.

We must do everything we can to stop this, because Trump could still win
the presidency. And regardless of the outcome of the next presidential

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

Last week, pregnant 31-year-old Kate Cox learned that her baby was
developing with an umbilical hernia, a twisted spine, and an irregular
heart and skull. It wouldn’t survive outside of the womb.

Her doctors told her that continuing the pregnancy could lead to serious
complications, including permanent infertility and death. But because of
the extreme abortion laws in Texas, they couldn’t help her.

In a last-ditch effort, Kate went to court seeking permission for an
emergency abortion. Yesterday, moved to tears by Cox’s story, the judge
ruled in her favor.

At last, some hard-won justice for a woman whose life depends on it.

But then, just hours later, Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton threatened
to throw Cox’s doctors in prison *for life* if they performed the
procedure.

In a state that already leads the country and much of the developed world
in its rate of maternal mortality, Republicans are now going woman by
woman, doctor by doctor, blocking access to lifesaving care.

| | Celebrating One Million Delivered!
---
| | In the past four weeks, Rural Americans United’s pro-Democratic radio spots have been heard one million times by listeners throughout Central Washington! For the very first time, thousands of people have been exposed to core Democratic goals with the power to vastly improve the lives of working class people on the eastside of the Cascades. In all, RAU has committed to a $350,000, 14-month media blitz, which will blanket the 4th District with 20,000 separate radio spots. In English and Spanish, the ads are believed to be the largest public awareness campaign ever launched in the state.
---
| |
---
| | The first month of RAU’s remarkable advertising campaign was met with a wave of support pouring in from across the state, thanking us for giving them hope and representation in communities that are often subjected to intimidation and even violence against those that hold democratic values. When I write us, I mean all of us that contribute, write notes of encouragement, support candidates, run for office and so many other things. Winning is never a singular accomplishment, it takes all of us. To keep these inspiring pro-Democratic broadcast messages rolling, Rural Americans United needs your financial support. Please help us celebrate the holiday season and the New Year with great joy, knowing the lives of so many have been touched with good and sensible values. We must raise $43,000 dollars before the end of the year to keep the momentum up. [Click here](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/ccOnAd8uC/c?w=RGS9q-bY4drt_0-tFcZ3RH9fyELbKy6XHVbD58AElJM.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3JhdV95ZWFyX2VuZF8yMDIzIiwiciI6IjIwOTJiNWVjLTBiOWMtNDg4ZC05ZGUzLTk2Y2VlOTY5YmQ0ZSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) to help RAU meet this year's funding goal.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/ccOnAd8uC/c?w=irwRGc4Kn-k1mHVhz0PRHM8i_8ZvU8gncydmJ3P_sg0.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3JhdV95ZWFyX2VuZF8yMDIzIiwiciI6ImYxZDIxMmQwLWNjNGQtNDRiYi1hNDFjLWEyMGE1MzkwYTliZSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)
---
| | |
---
| | Local Media GainsInterest in Democrats
---
| | We are making Central Washington Democrats newsworthy again! For thirty years or more Democrats have had little to no relationship with TV, radio and newspapers. Without solid Democratic political infrastructure, journalists seeking quotes from a Democrat are unsure where to turn. There is a continuous onslaught of Republican noise in Central Washington; but without Democratic media infrastructure, the business of creating responses and structuring information in a form that radio, TV and print journalists can use just doesn’t happen. Without sources for the Democratic side of stories, local media are left with only Republican party rhetoric while the Democratic voice diminishes.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/ccOnAd8uC/c?w=n1Za8HMEWFzAPXgYdiS-JktnrxG21A7nnvuutZU6LhE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL25ld3NsZXR0ZXItMTEuMDguMjMiLCJyIjoiYzZkZjA3NmMtN2YyOS00ODI1LThlNmYtNzBjZTYxZjg0ZTdmIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)
---
| | Starting two years ago, RAU began rebuilding these important relationships with the media to get our story out there. During the last election cycle we started to see the fruits of our efforts. We were able to get pro-Democratic articles published in papers up and down Central Washington as well as in Seattle and Spokane. Additionally, we placed articles calling out the heinous methods that local Republican parties are using to subvert the political process, undermine election integrity and unfairly sway voting to their benefit. As a result of our work, Central Washington media outlets are showing a new interest in Democrat content. We will continue to build on that success, working to increase the visibility and voice of rural Americans. Your generous support is making all the difference! A sample of publications are below.

For the very first time, thousands of people have been exposed to core Democratic goals with the power to vastly improve the lives of working class people on the eastside of the Cascades. In all, RAU has committed to a $350,000, 14-month media blitz, which will blanket the 4th District with 20,000 separate radio spots. In English and Spanish, the ads are believed to be the largest public awareness campaign ever launched in the state. | | | | The first month of RAU’s remarkable advertising campaign was met with a wave of support pouring in from across the state, thanking us for giving them hope and representation in communities that are often subjected to intimidation and even violence against those that hold democratic values. When I write us, I mean all of us that contribute, write notes of encouragement, support candidates, run for office and so many other things. Winning is never a singular accomplishment, it takes all of us. To keep these inspiring pro-Democratic broadcast messages rolling, Rural Americans United needs your financial support. Please help us celebrate the holiday season and the New Year with great joy, knowing the lives of so many have been touched with good and sensible values. We must raise $43,000 dollars before the end of the year to keep the momentum up. to help RAU meet this year's funding goal. | | | | | | | Local Media GainsInterest in Democrats | | We are making Central Washington Democrats newsworthy again! For thirty years or more Democrats have had little to no relationship with TV, radio and newspapers. Without solid Democratic political infrastructure, journalists seeking quotes from a Democrat are unsure where to turn. There is a continuous onslaught of Republican noise in Central Washington; but without Democratic media infrastructure, the business of creating responses and structuring information in a form that radio, TV and print journalists can use just doesn’t happen. Without sources for the Democratic side of stories, local media are left with only Republican party rhetoric while the Democratic voice diminishes. | | | | Starting two years ago, RAU began rebuilding these important relationships with the media to get our story out there. During the last election cycle we started to see the fruits of our efforts. We were able to get pro-Democratic articles published in papers up and down Central Washington as well as in Seattle and Spokane. Additionally, we placed articles calling out the heinous methods that local Republican parties are using to subvert the political process, undermine election integrity and unfairly sway voting to their benefit. As a result of our work, Central Washington media outlets are showing a new interest in Democrat content. We will continue to build on that success, working to increase the visibility and voice of rural Americans. Your generous support is making all the difference! Fellow Conservative, We’re living in a pivotal time. In many ways we are witnessing the dystopian nightmare of a culture moving further from Jesus -- not closer to Jesus. **_As believers in Biblical truth, we need to speak up to current Western civilization and all of humanity!_** To help equip Pastors and congregations to put our Christian faith into action, TPUSA Faith hosts **_Freedom Night in America_**. Through this monthly series, a guest speaker joins me to engage in discussions around topics such as sexuality, gender, and family life. **[Freedom Night in America is on a mission to strengthen the church and fight for liberty — which is God’s idea, not man’s idea. | Dear Fellow American,

I am reaching out today because I believe that you, like me, are concerned about the increasing trend of legal persecution against Americans who wish to live their lives according to their faith. Our cornerstones of faith, liberty, community, and life form the bedrock of our great nation, and we need your help to maintain them. [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/frxAed2ukwCtKzdlBPidew~~/AARclAA~~) From a high school football coach in Washington who lost his job for praying on the field (KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT), to a Colorado baker hauled through the legal system multiple times for not wanting to bake a cake that violated his religious convictions (MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION), we can't ignore the gradual erosion of religious freedom in America.

That's why I created the American Cornerstone Institute to advocate for commonsense solutions to these issues and to strengthen the bonds that keep our nation united. But we can't do it alone.

**We need your voice.**

I want to personally invite you to participate in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**You can share your thoughts using this secure link:[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/frxAed2ukwCtKzdlBPidew~~/AARclAA~~)**

Your responses are confidential and will be used solely towards furthering our advocacy efforts.

[Please, take a few minutes of your time to complete the survey.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/frxAed2ukwCtKzdlBPidew~~/AARclAA~~) Your input is vital in helping us understand the scope of these issues and develop impactful strategies to counteract them.

Your opinion truly matters. Together, we can ensure that religious liberty continues to thrive as an integral part of our American society.

For Liberty,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

Texas GOP rejects ban on Nazis
Peter,
I’m not often shocked by stories about GOP extremism. But this week I saw a story from the _Texas Tribune_ that I had to read twice:
**_TEXAS TRIBUNE_ : “Texas GOP executive committee rejects proposed ban on associating with Nazi sympathizers and Holocaust deniers”**

You may or may not know, Peter, that Juan Ciscomani will do just about anything to avoid questions relating to abortion rights.
Last cycle, when voters asked Ciscomani his stance on the issue, this was his response:

body:
This email is different from what we normally send, but I hope you’ll read it. | | Peter,

From the frontlines, I've seen firsthand what lack of access to routine preventative healthcare means for Americans, and I’m determined to find solutions. **[Before I share my plan, I’m asking for your help with a donation to my campaign>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74826271/442759235/1416552317?refcode=em23_231208_ACAIRF_fnd_gq_inac___DBW_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_231208_ACAIRF_fnd_gq_inac___DBW_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=0684dd2c-0096-ee11-8925-002248223f36&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDY4NGRkMmMtMDA5Ni1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Ab-IxuDOEmCMyB72li4RWP151mzfy-h8WLWwZ2JxU0c=)**

It is tragic that healthcare is still out of reach for the millions of uninsured. In Texas, our healthcare outcomes are some of the worst in the nation. **In 2021, nearly 20% of Texans were uninsured, and Texas children were more than twice as likely as children in other states to be uninsured. Texas also ranks #49 in the nation for women’s healthcare.**

Texans deserve better. That's why in Congress, I will fight to:
* **Offer a public option for health insurance so Americans will have expanded access and more choices in the Marketplace.**
* **Lower prescription drug costs.** For those lucky enough to see a doctor, there is still the burden of prescription drug costs. We must cap the cost of insulin for all Americans at $35 per month and hold drug companies accountable by putting patients over profits.
* **Incentivize research and development of Orphan Drugs. Far too many parents watch their children suffer with rare conditions for which treatments are unavailable or way too expensive.** There’s more we can do to ensure that pharmaceutical companies continue to research treatments and cures for rare conditions and that those treatments are fairly priced. I will fight for expanded resources for Orphan Drug research and work to increase awareness and support for this vital program in Washington.
* **Fight for expanding Medicaid and support legislation to encourage state legislators to change course in favor of helping millions of Texans receive the coverage they need.**
* **Increase transparency for patients in the healthcare system.** Insurance companies and corporate hospital systems have made it virtually impossible to get straightforward answers on what patients might pay out of pocket — so they can make more money at Texans’ expense. We must pass reforms that get Texans the information they deserve when emergencies strike.
* **Ensure women have the right to make decisions about their health — without the interference of politicians.** In Congress, I will vote to re-establish and protect the right to an abortion nationwide. I will also defend the right to birth control and oppose medically unnecessary requirements on abortion providers.

**This isn't just a list to me — these are tangible, research-driven goals that will help us create a Texas that can thrive.** In 2022, I worked with Democratic leaders in Washington on legislation to allow Medicare to negotiate drug prices, improve diversity in clinical trials, and increase accessibility to affordable healthcare. I also worked on federal legislation related to mental health reform, reproductive rights, Medicare, Medicaid, and more. **I am more than ready to commit to this work as your congressman for TX-32.**

**[But I can only do that if our campaign has the resources to win next November. This campaign is a team effort, and we need all of our supporters to chip in where they can. That’s why I hope today you’ll make a donation of $5 or whatever you can afford>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74826272/442759236/1416552317?refcode=em23_231208_ACAIRF_fnd_gq_inac___DBW_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_231208_ACAIRF_fnd_gq_inac___DBW_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=0684dd2c-0096-ee11-8925-002248223f36&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDY4NGRkMmMtMDA5Ni1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Ab-IxuDOEmCMyB72li4RWP151mzfy-h8WLWwZ2JxU0c=)** clean_body: This email is different from what we normally send, but I hope you’ll read it. | | Peter, From the frontlines, I've seen firsthand what lack of access to routine preventative healthcare means for Americans, and I’m determined to find solutions. = It is tragic that healthcare is still out of reach for the millions of uninsured. In Texas, our healthcare outcomes are some of the worst in the nation. In 2021, nearly 20% of Texans were uninsured, and Texas children were more than twice as likely as children in other states to be uninsured. Texas also ranks #49 in the nation for women’s healthcare. Texans deserve better. That's why in Congress, I will fight to: Offer a public option for health insurance so Americans will have expanded access and more choices in the Marketplace. Lower prescription drug costs. For those lucky enough to see a doctor, there is still the burden of prescription drug costs. We must cap the cost of insulin for all Americans at $35 per month and hold drug companies accountable by putting patients over profits. Incentivize research and development of Orphan Drugs. Far too many parents watch their children suffer with rare conditions for which treatments are unavailable or way too expensive. There’s more we can do to ensure that pharmaceutical companies continue to research treatments and cures for rare conditions and that those treatments are fairly priced. I will fight for expanded resources for Orphan Drug research and work to increase awareness and support for this vital program in Washington. Fight for expanding Medicaid and support legislation to encourage state legislators to change course in favor of helping millions of Texans receive the coverage they need. Increase transparency for patients in the healthcare system. Insurance companies and corporate hospital systems have made it virtually impossible to get straightforward answers on what patients might pay out of pocket — so they can make more money at Texans’ expense. We must pass reforms that get Texans the information they deserve when emergencies strike. Ensure women have the right to make decisions about their health — without the interference of politicians. In Congress, I will vote to re-establish and protect the right to an abortion nationwide. I will also defend the right to birth control and oppose medically unnecessary requirements on abortion providers. This isn't just a list to me — these are tangible, research-driven goals that will help us create a Texas that can thrive. In 2022, I worked with Democratic leaders in Washington on legislation to allow Medicare to negotiate drug prices, improve diversity in clinical trials, and increase accessibility to affordable healthcare. I also worked on federal legislation related to mental health reform, reproductive rights, Medicare, Medicaid, and more. I am more than ready to commit to this work as your congressman for TX-32. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- = | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- We can, and we WILL do better. | | | **Pearl Harbor Remembrance Day: Honor and Reflect with Us****
**
---

Dear Peter,
Yesterday, as we observed Pearl Harbor Remembrance Day, we honored the memory of those who bravely faced one of the darkest moments in our nation's history. It is a day to reflect on the courage and resilience that define the American spirit, values that continue to guide us in Washington's 8th legislative district.

And the reason why is that they felt that he was the most direct, he answered the questions honestly and candidly, and that he held other candidates’ feet to the fire. We’ve been waiting for this performance for some time. Chris Christie proved that he is not just a brilliant debater, but he knows how to hold other candidates accountable.” : “This was Chris Christie’s night, I think. I mean, he was on fire from the very beginning, he was telling the truth.” : “DeSantis avoided answering the question and I think that was a really strong point for Chris Christie , when he said, ‘look, I’m a regular guy, I can answer a question that’s asked, simply, yes or no.’” : “ Winners: Chris Christie ” “But DeSantis was caught unawares by former New Jersey Gov. Chris Christie, who delivered a biting performance that at times got the better of all of his opponents. Christie called out DeSantis for refusing to answer a question on Trump's mental fitness for office, with the Florida governor momentarily seeming at a loss for words.” : “ Christie Gets His Groove Back ” “In Tuscaloosa, the former New Jersey governor tapped back into some of that energy, portraying his opponents as immature, annoying and not ready for the job.” “But only Christie made a sustained case against the former president — a theme he returned to in his closing statement, when he said Trump wouldn’t be allowed to vote in the 2024 election because ‘he will be convicted of felonies before then.'" : “ Chris Christie, Fresh Off Feisty Debate, Courts Voters in New Hampshires. Mr. Christie rejoined the campaign trail, energized by a debate performance in which he seized the spotlight with attacks on Mr. Trump and his rivals.” : “ Actually answering the question? What an unexpected treat in a presidential debate. This was Christie at his very best. He shut down Ramaswamy, defended Haley and acknowledged the reality of Trump. Republican primary voters should embrace people willing to tell them the unpopular truth.” : “[Christie] embarrassed DeSantis by badgering him for dodging straight answers, and he came across as bolder and more distinct than Haley.” : ”The story of the Christie candidacy remains the same. The former prosecutor is a very skilled debater who can deliver more scathing one-liners than anyone else on the stage. Perhaps the most memorable on Wednesday was his contention that Ramaswamy was ‘the most obnoxious blowhard in America.’” After such a strong performance, Chris now has the momentum to surge in New Hampshire! Last night, my family celebrated the first night of Chanukah, an eight day Jewish holiday celebrating the human spirit. _Chanukah reminds all of us the value of perseverance in the face of adversity._ As I think back on all that our state and our nation have endured over the past few years, I’m reminded that we are strongest when we stand together for a common purpose. My Jewish heritage is extremely important to me. As the granddaughter of a Holocaust victim, I learned from a young age what can happen when we turn away from one another. Growing up, my father instilled in me the importance of social justice and the need to look out for one another – which ultimately pushed me to go into public service in Vermont. **This holiday season (and always), I’m grateful for Vermont, I am grateful for our communities, and I am grateful for you. ** Wishing you peace, joy, and hope this holiday season, Becca Balint
